XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Galwaf yn awr ar lefarwyr y pleidiau i holi'r Gweinidog Cabinet. Yn gyntaf, Llefarydd Reform UK, Iain McIntosh.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: I now call on the party spokespeople to question the Cabinet Minister. First, the Reform UK spokesperson, Iain McIntosh.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Diolch, Lywydd. Before I address the Minister, I just wanted to correct the record on something the First Minister said earlier, when he suggested that all Reform Members want to take down the Welsh flag. I can't call that a lie, but I would like to say it's deliberately misleading, because we don't want to do that. I would like to suggest that he perhaps concentrates on his own Members, some of whom seem intent on merging the Welsh flag with the Palestinian flag. I'll leave that there. Thank you. [Interruption.]

To address the Minister: Cabinet Minister, how much taxpayers' money has the Welsh Government committed to pursuing Welsh independence, including establishing the new national commission and seeking powers to hold an independence referendum? Even a recent poll commissioned by the pro-independence organisation Yes Cymru found that only 32 per cent of likely voters would consider supporting independence. So, there is clearly no blanket support for independence across Wales at all. At a time when the NHS, our schools, councils and front-line services are under enormous financial pressure, do you really believe that this is an appropriate use of taxpayers' money, and will you please publish the full projected cost of pursuing this agenda over the course of this Senedd term?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Diolch, Lywydd. Cyn i mi siarad â'r Gweinidog, roeddwn i'n awyddus i gywiro'r cofnod ynglŷn â rhywbeth a ddywedodd y Prif Weinidog yn gynharach, pan awgrymodd ef fod pob Aelod Reform yn dymuno tynnu baner Cymru i lawr. Ni allaf i alw hwnnw'n gelwydd, ond fe hoffwn i ddweud bod hynny'n fwriadol gamarweiniol, oherwydd nid ydym ni'n dymuno gwneud hynny. Fe hoffwn i awgrymu ei fod efallai yn canolbwyntio ar ei Aelodau ei hun, ac mae hi'n ymddangos bod rhai ohonyn nhw'n bwriadu cyfuno baner Cymru â baner Palestina. Ni ddywedaf i ddim yn rhagor. Diolch i chi. [Torri ar draws.]

Gan droi at y Gweinidog: Weinidog Cabinet, faint o arian trethdalwyr y mae Llywodraeth Cymru wedi ei ymrwymo ar gyfer mynd ar drywydd annibyniaeth i Gymru, yn cynnwys sefydlu'r comisiwn cenedlaethol newydd a cheisio pwerau i gynnal refferendwm ar annibyniaeth? Roedd arolwg diweddar a gomisiynwyd gan y sefydliad o blaid annibyniaeth sef Yes Cymru hyd yn oed yn canfod mai dim ond 32 y cant o'r pleidleiswyr tebygol a fyddai'n ystyried cefnogi annibyniaeth. Felly, mae hi'n amlwg nad oes yna gefnogaeth gyffredinol o gwbl i annibyniaeth ledled Cymru. Mewn cyfnod pan fo'r GIG, ein hysgolion, ein cynghorau a'n gwasanaethau rheng flaen dan bwysau ariannol enfawr, a ydych chi wir yn credu mai dyma ddefnydd priodol o arian trethdalwyr, ac a wnewch chi gyhoeddi'r gost lawn a ragwelir o fynd ar drywydd yr agenda hon yn ystod tymor y Senedd hon?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Well, I welcome the Member to his new position on the Reform frontbench. Had he been at a previous question time, he would have heard me say from this position that this Government is committed to delivering on its priorities for the people of Wales—on childcare, on child poverty, on the economy, on educational standards and on tackling waiting lists. Those are our priorities. That mission is underpinned by standing up for Wales, and we make no apology for seeking devolution of the Crown Estate, for the very reasons we've heard outlined earlier, for improving our rail services, and for making our communities safer by devolving policing. That is our agenda as a Government, as I set out in my oral statement on the priorities on the constitution.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Wel, rwy'n croesawu'r Aelod i'w swydd newydd ar fainc flaen Reform. Pe byddai ef wedi bod yn bresennol yn ystod amser cwestiynau blaenorol, fe fyddai ef wedi fy nghlywed i'n dweud o'r safle hwn fod y Llywodraeth hon wedi ymrwymo i gyflawni ei blaenoriaethau er mwyn pobl Cymru—o ran gofal plant, o ran tlodi plant, o ran yr economi, o ran safonau addysgol ac o ran mynd i'r afael â rhestrau aros. Y rhain yw ein blaenoriaethau ni. Cafodd y gorchwyl hwnnw ei seilio ar sefyll dros Gymru, ac nid ydym ni'n ymddiheuro am geisio datganoli Ystad y Goron, am yr union resymau y clywsom yn cael eu hamlinellu yn gynharach, nac am wella ein gwasanaethau rheilffyrdd, nac am wneud ein cymunedau ni'n fwy diogel trwy ddatganoli plismona. Honno yw ein hagenda ni yn y Llywodraeth, fel nodais i yn fy natganiad llafar ar y blaenoriaethau o ran y cyfansoddiad.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Diolch, Lywydd. You answered a question I didn't put to you, but, anyway, I'll try again with a different one. Mine was about devolution, but anyway—sorry, about independence. 

Cabinet Minister, how are Wales's taxpayers actually supposed to know whether the Welsh Government is delivering value for their money? Billions of pounds are spent every year across numerous programmes, projects and initiatives, but spending money is not the same as delivering results. So, will you publish clear performance data showing what every Welsh Government programme is supposed to achieve, how much it costs, whether it is on time, and, crucially, whether it is actually working? Now, when a programme repeatedly fails to deliver results or value for money, will you reform it or scrap it altogether, rather than continuing to pour taxpayers' money into something that simply isn't working?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Diolch, Lywydd. Fe wnaethoch chi ateb cwestiwn na wnes i ei ofyn i chi, ond, beth bynnag am hynny, fe roddaf i gynnig arall arni gydag un gwahanol. Roedd fy nghwestiwn i'n ymwneud â datganoli, ond beth bynnag—mae'n ddrwg gen i, ag annibyniaeth.

Weinidog Cabinet, sut caiff trethdalwyr Cymru wybod mewn gwirionedd a yw Llywodraeth Cymru yn cynnig gwerth am eu harian? Mae biliynau o bunnau yn cael eu gwario bob blwyddyn ar draws nifer o raglenni, prosiectau a mentrau, ond nid yw gwario arian yn golygu cyflawni canlyniadau. Felly, a wnewch chi gyhoeddi data perfformiad eglur sy'n dangos yr hyn y mae pob rhaglen gan Lywodraeth Cymru i fod i'w gyflawni, faint mae hynny'n ei gostio, a yw hynny'n digwydd ar amser, ac, yn hollbwysig, a yw'n gweithio mewn gwirionedd? Nawr, pan fydd rhaglen yn methu â chyflawni canlyniadau na rhoi gwerth am arian dro ar ôl tro, a wnewch chi ei diwygio hi neu ei dileu hi'n gyfan gwbl, yn hytrach na dal ati i dywallt arian trethdalwyr i rywbeth nad yw'n gweithio?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: There's a simple answer to that question, which is 'yes', because, as a Government, we are committed to outcomes. We have been critical of previous Governments who have poured money into projects and focused on inputs and outputs rather than outcomes that people can feel in their daily lives across the country. Part of my role is to challenge and to work with every one of my Cabinet colleagues to look at those Government programmes, to ensure that we are both getting value for taxpayers' money and ensuring that we're delivering outcomes for people right across Wales, whether that's on childcare, on the economy, on education—change that people can feel.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Mae ateb syml i'r cwestiwn hwnnw, sef 'gwnawn', oherwydd, yn y Llywodraeth, rydym ni wedi ymrwymo i ganlyniadau. Rydym ni wedi bod yn feirniadol o Lywodraethau blaenorol sydd wedi tywallt arian i brosiectau ac wedi canolbwyntio ar fewnbynnau ac allbynnau yn hytrach na chanlyniadau y gall pobl eu teimlo nhw yn eu bywydau bob dydd ledled y wlad. Rhan o'm swyddogaeth i yw herio a gweithio gyda phob un o'r cyd-Aelodau yn y Cabinet i edrych ar y rhaglenni hynny gan y Llywodraeth, i sicrhau ein bod ni'n cael gwerth am arian trethdalwyr a sicrhau ein bod ni'n cyflawni canlyniadau er mwyn pobl ledled Cymru, boed hynny o ran gofal plant, o ran yr economi, o ran addysg—newid y gall pobl ei deimlo.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Okay. Thank you for that one. Cabinet Minister, I would also like to know why does the Welsh Government keep creating more bureaucracy instead of reducing it. Since 2018, 16 new devolved public bodies have now been created, whilst only five have been replaced or abolished, but now your Government wants to actually create even more. Now, every new body means more boards, more senior executives, more administration and, unfortunately, more cost to the taxpayer. So, when are you actually going to start reducing the machinery of Government? Will you identify which arm's-length bodies duplicate work that is already being done elsewhere, publish what each one costs, and commit to merging or abolishing those that are simply not necessary? Government efficiency shouldn't mean managing even more bureaucracy; it really should mean having the courage to get rid of it if isn't working.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Iawn. Diolch i chi am hynna. Weinidog Cabinet, fe hoffwn i wybod hefyd pam mae Llywodraeth Cymru yn dal i greu mwy o fiwrocratiaeth yn hytrach na chyfyngu ar hynny. Ers 2018, mae 16 o gyrff cyhoeddus datganoledig newydd wedi cael eu creu erbyn hyn, er mai dim ond pump a gafodd eu disodli neu eu diddymu, ond nawr mae eich Llywodraeth yn awyddus i greu rhagor eto. Nawr, mae pob corff newydd yn golygu mwy o fyrddau, mwy o uwch swyddogion, mwy o weinyddiaeth ac, yn anffodus, mwy o gost i'r trethdalwr. Felly, pryd fyddwch chi'n dechrau cwtogi ar beirianwaith Llywodraeth? A wnewch chi nodi pa gyrff hyd braich sy'n dyblygu gwaith sydd eisoes yn cael ei wneud mewn mannau eraill, a chyhoeddi faint mae pob un yn ei gostio, ac a wnewch chi ymrwymo i uno neu ddiddymu'r rhai nad ydyn nhw'n angenrheidiol? Ni ddylai effeithlonrwydd y llywodraeth olygu rheoli mwy fyth o fiwrocratiaeth; fe ddylai olygu bod â dewrder i gael gwared ar rywbeth os nad yw hynny'n gweithio.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Again, I thank the Member for the question. This Government has a very limited set of bodies that it seeks to set up. There has been widespread debate about the national economic development agency. There is widespread consensus across this Chamber that the Welsh economy is not performing as it should, and an arm's-length, business-driven development agency is a clear way forward there. However, I share the Member's scepticism for the proliferation of bureaucracy, for more bodies for bodies' sake. You will be aware that the Government publishes the budget and the grant letter for every Government sponsored body on an annual basis. Where there are efficiencies to be gained, I will certainly pursue them. Thank you.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Unwaith eto, rwy'n diolch i'r Aelod am y cwestiwn. Mae gan y Llywodraeth hon set gyfyngedig iawn o gyrff y mae'n ceisio eu sefydlu nhw. Fe fu yna ddadl eang am yr asiantaeth datblygu economaidd genedlaethol. Mae consensws eang ar draws y Siambr hon nad yw economi Cymru yn perfformio fel y dylai hi, ac mae asiantaeth ddatblygu hyd braich, sy'n cael ei hysgogi gan fusnes yn ffordd eglur ymlaen yn hyn o beth. Serch hynny, rwy'n rhannu amheuaeth yr Aelod ynglŷn ag amlhau biwrocratiaeth, am fod â rhagor o gyrff er eu mwyn eu hunain. Rydych chi'n siŵr o fod yn ymwybodol bod y Llywodraeth yn cyhoeddi'r gyllideb a'r llythyr grant ar gyfer pob corff a noddir gan y Llywodraeth yn flynyddol. Lle bydd effeithlonrwydd i'w gael, yn sicr fe fyddaf i'n mynd ar drywydd hynny. Diolch i chi.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Llefarydd Llafur Cymru, Huw Thomas.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: The Welsh Labour spokesperson, Huw Thomas.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch, Lywydd. Mae yna lot o sylwadau wedi cael eu gwneud dros yr wythnosau diwethaf am faterion cyfansoddiadol. Dwi eisiau ffocysu ar beth sydd yn bwysig i bobl Cymru, a dyna pam dwi am holi cwestiynau ar y rhaglen lywodraethu.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Thank you, Llywydd. Many comments have been made over recent weeks on constitutional issues. I want to focus on what's important to the people of Wales, and that's why I want to ask questions on the programme for government.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Minister, the programme for government, which you have overall oversight for, is full of references to collaboration and it's also very strong—there's a whole section on it—about supporting teachers. But, last week, an overwhelming majority of school leaders voted to support industrial action in response to your Government's priorities and policies. Ninety-three per cent of NAHT members voted, and 72.5 per cent of them indicated they would be prepared to take industrial action. Why does the Minister think the programme for government has been so poorly received by school leaders? Can you confirm that intensive negotiations with NAHT are now taking place, and what progress is the Government making?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Weinidog, mae'r rhaglen lywodraethu, y mae pawb ohonoch chi â goruchwyliaeth gyffredinol arni, yn llawn o gyfeiriadau at gydweithio ac yn gadarn iawn hefyd—mae yna adran gyfan ar y pwnc—o ran cefnogi athrawon. Ond, yr wythnos diwethaf, fe bleidleisiodd mwyafrif llethol o arweinwyr ysgolion i gefnogi gweithredu diwydiannol mewn ymateb i flaenoriaethau a pholisïau eich Llywodraeth chi. Fe bleidleisiodd naw deg tri y cant o aelodau Cymdeithas Genedlaethol y Prifathrawon, ac roedd 72.5 y cant ohonyn nhw'n nodi y bydden nhw'n barod i gymryd camau diwydiannol. Pam mae'r Gweinidog yn credu bod y rhaglen lywodraethu wedi cael derbyniad mor wael gan arweinwyr ysgolion? A wnewch chi gadarnhau bod trafodaethau dwys yn digwydd gyda Chymdeithas Genedlaethol y Prifathrawon nawr, a pha gynnydd mae'r Llywodraeth yn ei wneud?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch am y cwestiwn.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Thank you for the question.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: I think what we're seeing across the public services in Wales is a legacy of a decade and more of austerity that has seen cuts and challenges, and public services that are genuinely facing crisis point. I am very pleased that my colleague the Minister for education has been engaging effectively with a range of teaching unions. There's been more progress with some than others. I said in my earlier answer that trade union colleagues and us will not always agree. Those negotiations are ongoing, and I'm sure we would all wish to see a positive conclusion to those negotiations. My colleague the Cabinet Minister for education has focused on raising standards in our schools, and if we are to achieve that, it must be done in collaboration and co-operation with both the teachers and those who lead our schools.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Rwy'n credu mai'r hyn yr ydym ni'n ei weld ar draws y gwasanaethau cyhoeddus yng Nghymru yw etifeddiaeth degawd a mwy o gyni a welodd doriadau a heriau, a gwasanaethau cyhoeddus yn wynebu pwynt argyfwng gwirioneddol. Rwy'n falch iawn fod fy nghyd-Weinidog y Gweinidog dros addysg wedi bod yn ymgysylltu yn effeithiol ag ystod o undebau addysgu. Mae mwy o gynnydd wedi bod gyda rhai na gydag eraill. Fe ddywedais i yn fy ateb cynharach na fydd cydweithwyr yn yr undebau llafur o'r un farn â ni bob amser. Mae'r trafodaethau hynny'n parhau, ac rwy'n siŵr y byddem ni i gyd yn dymuno gweld terfyniad cadarnhaol i'r trafodaethau hynny. Mae fy nghyd-Weinidog y Gweinidog Cabinet dros addysg wedi bod yn canolbwyntio ar godi safonau yn ein hysgolion, ac os ydym ni am gyflawni hynny, fe fydd rhaid gwneud hynny wrth gydweithio ac mewn cydweithrediad â'r athrawon a'r rhai sy'n arwain ein hysgolion.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch, Weinidog. I applaud the answer you gave earlier in response to Reform's attack on trade unions, and I should declare myself a member of many of them, including Unite, because I'm going to come on to this. You talk about social partnership, you talk about Government efficiency, and there's a clear link between both, but at your own party conference this weekend, you had a delegation of health visitors from Cwm Taf, who are Unite members, who've been on strike. They heard a political priority from the First Minister that he would resolve their dispute, and they believe he's lied. Those are their words—that he's failed to keep his promise. As the Minister responsible for keeping the Government's priorities, do you regret the First Minister's failure to keep his promise? We now have the longest running nursing strike in NHS Wales history. To secure efficiency of the NHS, what will you do to resolve the issue?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Diolch, Weinidog. Rwy'n cymeradwyo'r ateb y gwnaethoch chi ei roi yn gynharach mewn ymateb i ymosodiad gan Reform ar yr undebau llafur, ac fe ddylwn i ddatgan fy mod i fy hun yn aelod o lawer ohonyn nhw, gan gynnwys Unite, oherwydd fe fyddaf i'n symud ymlaen at hyn. Rydych chi'n siarad am bartneriaeth gymdeithasol, rydych chi'n siarad am effeithlonrwydd y Llywodraeth, ac mae cysylltiad eglur rhwng y ddau, ond yng nghynhadledd eich plaid chi eich hun y penwythnos hwn, roedd gennych chi ddirprwyaeth o ymwelwyr iechyd yno o Gwm Taf, sy'n aelodau o Unite, sydd wedi bod ar streic. Fe gawson nhw glywed am flaenoriaeth wleidyddol y Prif Weinidog y byddai ef yn datrys eu hanghydfod, ac maen nhw o'r farn ei fod ef wedi dweud celwydd. Eu geiriau nhw oedd y rhain—ei fod ef wedi methu â chadw ei addewid. Yn Weinidog sy'n gyfrifol am gadw blaenoriaethau'r Llywodraeth, a ydych chi'n drist oherwydd methiant y Prif Weinidog i gadw ei addewid? Dyma'r streic nyrsio hiraf yn hanes GIG Cymru. Ar gyfer sicrhau effeithlonrwydd y GIG, beth fyddwch chi'n ei wneud i ddatrys y broblem?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
As my colleague will know full well, the Cabinet Minister for health is responsible for the health service and our health priorities, and has set out our approach and our encouragement to all of those partners in the debate in Cwm Taf, to reach a negotiated conclusion. We very much hope that will happen at the soonest time possible.

The point more generally about the NHS is an important one. People right across Wales are currently being let down by a service that has not invested significantly enough in tackling waiting lists. We have invested, as the First Minister said earlier, £145 million in bringing down waiting lists, because the impact of that on individuals, on families, on workplaces right across Wales is unconscionable, and those are our priorities as a Government.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Fel gŵyr fy nghyd-Weinidog i'n dda iawn, y Gweinidog Cabinet dros iechyd sy'n gyfrifol am y gwasanaeth iechyd a'n blaenoriaethau iechyd, ac mae ef wedi nodi ein dull gweithredu a'n hanogaeth ni i'r partneriaid hynny i gyd sydd yn y ddadl yng Nghwm Taf, ar gyfer cael terfyniad cytunedig. Rydym ni'n gobeithio yn fawr y bydd hynny'n digwydd cyn gynted â phosibl.

Mae'r pwynt yn fwy cyffredinol am y GIG yn un pwysig. Mae pobl ledled Cymru yn cael eu siomi ar hyn o bryd gan wasanaeth sydd heb weld buddsoddiad yn sylweddol o ran mynd i'r afael â rhestrau aros. Rydym ni wedi buddsoddi, fel dywedodd y Prif Weinidog yn gynharach, £145 miliwn ar gyfer byrhau rhestrau aros, oherwydd mae effaith hynny ar unigolion, ar deuluoedd, ar weithleoedd ledled Cymru yn anhygoel, a'r rhain yw ein blaenoriaethau ni yn y Llywodraeth.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Llefarydd y Ceidwadwyr Cymreig, Sam Rowlands.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: The Welsh Conservatives' spokesperson, Sam Rowlands.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch, Lywydd. As the Cabinet Minister for effectiveness, what actions are you taking to guarantee that your Cabinet colleagues are effectively ensuring value for money in the departments across the Welsh Government?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Diolch, Lywydd. Yn Weinidog Cabinet dros effeithiolrwydd, pa gamau a ydych chi'n eu cymryd i warantu bod eich cyd-Aelodau yn y Cabinet yn sicrhau gwerth am arian yn effeithiol yn yr adrannau ar draws Llywodraeth Cymru?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: One of the areas that we are looking at as a centralised Cabinet office in the Government is looking right across our Government priorities and ensuring that there is effective delivery on those and there is effective value for money. I know my colleague the Cabinet Minister for Finance has been engaging with Cabinet colleagues about their budgets for the year ahead, working closely with them to ensure that there is value for money at the heart of those programmes. Government effectiveness is about value for money, it is about delivering outcomes for people, and it comes back to the question posed earlier: if there are programmes that are not delivering measurable, tangible outcomes for people in communities right across Wales, then we should indeed reconsider them.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Un o'r meysydd yr ydym ni'n eu hystyried fel swyddfa Cabinet ganolog yn y Llywodraeth yw edrych dros ein blaenoriaethau ni i gyd yn y Llywodraeth a sicrhau bod cyflawniad effeithiol ar y rhain a bod gwerth effeithiol am arian. Fe wn i fod fy nghyd-Weinidog, y Gweinidog Cabinet dros Gyllid, wedi bod yn ymgysylltu â chyd-Weinidogion yn y Cabinet ynglŷn â'u cyllidebau nhw ar gyfer y flwyddyn i ddod, gan weithio'n agos gyda nhw i sicrhau bod gwerth am arian wrth hanfod y rhaglenni hynny. Mae effeithiolrwydd y llywodraeth yn ymwneud â gwerth am arian, mae'n ymwneud â chyflawni canlyniadau i bobl, ac mae hyn yn dychwelyd at y cwestiwn a ofynnwyd yn gynharach: os oes yna raglenni nad ydyn nhw'n cyflawni canlyniadau y gellir eu mesur, sy'n ddiriaethol i bobl mewn cymunedau ledled Cymru, yna fe ddylem ni eu hailystyried nhw mewn gwirionedd.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Thank you for your response, Cabinet Minister. You'll know, in July, that your colleague the Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport announced that the Welsh Government will be setting up a new shadow broadcasting and communications authority as a first step in trying to pull powers over broadcasting away from the UK Government. And you'll know, of course, that broadcasting has never been devolved, so setting up the shadow authority is clearly an example of this Plaid Cymru Welsh Government working outside of its constitutional boundaries. And, of course, as the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution, I'm sure you were the first to object to these plans at the earliest opportunity.

At the same time, your colleague also announced that tens of thousands of pounds have been set aside to fund the shadow authority in its first year. And, of course, because it's not a devolved matter, there's no funding from the UK Government to enable this to happen, meaning every penny spent on the shadow authority has to be redirected from an area the Welsh Government does have responsibility for. So, Cabinet Minister, do you think that this is an effective use of taxpayers' money that the Welsh Government is spending tens of thousands of pounds on something it has no responsibility for?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Diolch i chi am eich ymateb, Weinidog Cabinet. Rydych chi'n siŵr o fod yn gwybod, ym mis Gorffennaf, fod eich cyd-Weinidog chi, y Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon, wedi cyhoeddi y bydd Llywodraeth Cymru yn sefydlu awdurdod darlledu a chyfathrebu cysgodol newydd yn gam cyntaf mewn ymgais i dynnu pwerau dros ddarlledu oddi wrth Lywodraeth y DU. Ac fe wyddoch chi, wrth gwrs, na chafodd darlledu ei ddatganoli erioed, ac felly mae sefydlu'r awdurdod cysgodol yn enghraifft eglur o Lywodraeth Cymru Plaid Cymru yma'n gweithio'r tu draw i'w ffiniau cyfansoddiadol. Ac, wrth gwrs, yn Weinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd y Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad, rwy'n siŵr mai chi fyddai'r cyntaf i wrthwynebu'r cynlluniau hyn ar y cyfle cynharaf.

Ar yr un pryd, fe gyhoeddodd eich cyd-Weinidog chi hefyd fod degau o filoedd o bunnau wedi cael eu neilltuo i ariannu'r awdurdod cysgodol yn ei flwyddyn gyntaf. Ac, wrth gwrs, am nad yw hwnnw'n fater datganoledig, nid oes unrhyw gyllid gan Lywodraeth y DU i ganiatáu i hyn ddigwydd, sy'n golygu ei bod hi'n rhaid ailgyfeirio pob ceiniog a gaiff ei wario ar yr awdurdod cysgodol o faes y mae Llywodraeth Cymru yn gyfrifol amdano. Felly, Weinidog Cabinet, a ydych chi o'r farn mai dyma ddefnydd effeithiol o arian trethdalwyr sef bod Llywodraeth Cymru yn gwario degau o filoedd o bunnau ar rywbeth nad oes ganddi unrhyw gyfrifoldeb amdano?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: I think if anyone had seen the evidence from colleagues in the media, in BBC and in S4C, to the culture committee in Westminster and in other places on the challenges facing the media landscape, and the very real challenges facing the media landscape right across Wales, they would understand that broadcasting in Wales would be in a stronger place if it was indeed devolved. That is why this Government is committed to the devolution of broadcasting, so that we can have effective media, so that we can have effective scrutiny of this Government, amongst other things. That is what we support, and we make no apology for supporting that.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Rwyf i o'r farn pe byddai unrhyw un wedi gweld y dystiolaeth gan gydweithwyr yn y cyfryngau, yn y BBC ac yn S4C, i'r pwyllgor diwylliant yn San Steffan ac mewn mannau eraill o ran yr heriau sy'n wynebu tirwedd y cyfryngau, a'r heriau gwirioneddol iawn sy'n wynebu tirwedd y cyfryngau ledled Cymru, y byddai yn deall y byddai darlledu yng Nghymru ar dir mwy cadarn pe bai'n cael ei ddatganoli mewn gwirionedd. Dyna pam mae'r Llywodraeth hon wedi ymrwymo i ddatganoli darlledu, er mwyn i ni fod â chyfryngau effeithiol, er mwyn i ni fod â chraffu effeithiol ar y Llywodraeth hon, ymhlith pethau eraill. Dyna'r hyn yr ydym ni'n ei gefnogi, ac nid ydym ni'n ymddiheuro o gwbl am gefnogi hynny.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Gwneud Penderfyniadau gan y Llywodraeth a'r Sector Cyhoeddus
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Government and Public Sector Decision Making

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: 3. Pa asesiad y mae'r Gweinidog Cabinet wedi'i wneud o'r modd y gall ystadegau gefnogi o ran gwneud penderfyniadau mwy effeithiol gan y llywodraeth a'r sector cyhoeddus ledled Cymru? OQ64626
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: 3. What assessment has the Cabinet Minister made of how statistics can support more effective government and public sector decision making across Wales? OQ64626

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch, Safa. Trustworthy statistics play a vital role in effective decision making across Wales. They help us understand where need is greatest, target resources effectively and judge whether outcomes are improving. As a Government, we are committed to using high-quality evidence to shape policy and delivery, and to publish clear outcomes that strengthen accountability.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Diolch, Safa. Mae gan ystadegau dibynadwy ran hanfodol wrth wneud penderfyniadau effeithiol ledled Cymru. Maen nhw'n ein help ni ddeall ym mha le mae'r angen mwyaf, i dargedu adnoddau yn effeithiol a barnu a yw canlyniadau yn gwella. Yn y Llywodraeth, rydym ni wedi ymrwymo i ddefnyddio tystiolaeth o ansawdd uchel i lunio polisi a chyflawni, a chyhoeddi canlyniadau eglur sy'n grymuso atebolrwydd.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch, Cabinet Minister. Evidence-based decision making is central to delivering effective public service and ensuring the best use of public money. In healthcare, for example, we know that additional capacity can sometimes be needed to reduce waiting times. Audit Wales has highlighted that insourcing and outsourcing can help reduce long waits, but that it can also place additional pressure on NHS finances down the line, whilst opportunities remain to improve productivity within NHS services. So, Cabinet Minister, how is the Welsh Government ensuring that decisions on improving and delivering effective public services are not just informed by immediate cost savings or short-term deliveries, but also on sustainability, long-term outcomes and capacity building?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Diolch, Weinidog Cabinet. Mae gwneud penderfyniadau sy'n seiliedig ar dystiolaeth yn ganolog ar gyfer darparu gwasanaeth cyhoeddus effeithiol a sicrhau'r defnydd gorau o arian cyhoeddus. O ran gofal iechyd, er enghraifft, fe wyddom ni y gall angen fod weithiau am gapasiti ychwanegol i fyrhau amseroedd aros. Mae Archwilio Cymru wedi tynnu sylw at allu mewnoli ac allanoli i helpu i fyrhau arosiadau hir, ond y gall hynny roi pwysau ychwanegol ar gyllid y GIG ymhen amser hefyd, tra bod cyfleoedd yn parhau o ran gwella cynhyrchiant yng ngwasanaethau'r GIG. Felly, Weinidog Cabinet, sut mae Llywodraeth Cymru yn sicrhau bod penderfyniadau o ran gwella a darparu gwasanaethau cyhoeddus yn effeithiol yn cael eu llywio nid gan arbedion costau ar unwaith neu gyflawniadau byrdymor, ond gan gynaliadwyedd, canlyniadau hirdymor a datblygu capasiti hefyd?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch yn fawr. The Member, from her professional background, speaks clearly from experience. I believe there is more work to be done in the NHS on improving productivity. I also believe that throwing money at a problem as a sticking plaster is not a long-term solution. Decisions should be informed by evidence on outcomes, value for money and long-term sustainability, not simply the upfront costs. Health economics is an important part of that evidence base, helping decision makers understand what delivers the best outcomes from available resources. For example, health economics is being used in our work as a Government to bring care closer to home, often referred to as Community by Design, including community resource teams, virtual wards, integrated community hubs for health and social care.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Diolch yn fawr. Mae'r Aelod, o'i chefndir proffesiynol hi, yn siarad yn groyw o brofiad. Rwy'n credu bod mwy o waith i'w wneud yn y GIG o ran gwella cynhyrchiant. Rwyf o'r farn hefyd nad yw taflu arian at broblem fel datrysiad dros dro yn ddatrysiad i'r hirdymor. Fe ddylai penderfyniadau gael eu llywio gan dystiolaeth o ran canlyniadau, gwerth am arian a chynaliadwyedd hirdymor, nid yn unig o ran y costau ymlaen llaw. Mae economeg iechyd yn rhan bwysig o'r sylfaen honno o dystiolaeth, sy'n cynorthwyo'r rhai sy'n gwneud penderfyniadau wrth ddeall pa beth sy'n cyflawni'r canlyniadau gorau gyda'r adnoddau sydd ar gael. Er enghraifft, mae economeg iechyd yn cael ei defnyddio yn ein gwaith ni yn y Llywodraeth i ddod â gofal yn nes at y cartref, y cyfeirir at hynny fel Cymunedol o’r Cychwyn yn aml, gan gynnwys timau adnoddau cymunedol, wardiau rhithwir, canolfannau cymunedol integredig ar gyfer iechyd a gofal cymdeithasol.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Minister, good workforce data should, obviously, allow Governments to anticipate pressures rather than respond when they reach crisis point. How will your Government's data on recruitment, retention and workforce pressures to engage with our trade unions earlier actually help prevent some of those pressures ultimately escalating into industrial disputes? And talking of understanding our workforce, it is important, of course, for me to also reference that TUC Cymru has consistently gathered evidence about the experiences of workers in Wales because good policy obviously does start with good data. And I think that some of the mentions in relation to funding and social partnership—. Of course, Wales union learning fund funding provides funding for unions to encourage and support work-placed learning specifically, and it's about skills, and, of course, the TUC has very cleared referenced that 100,000 workers in Wales have benefited as a result of that funding in recent years.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Weinidog, fe ddylai data gweithlu da, yn amlwg, ganiatáu i Lywodraethau ragweld pwysau yn hytrach nag adweithio wrth gyrraedd sefyllfa o argyfwng. Sut fydd data eich Llywodraeth o ran recriwtio, cadw a phwysau gweithlu i ymgysylltu â'n hundebau llafur yn gynharach yn helpu i atal peth o'r pwysau hwnnw rhag arwain at anghydfodau diwydiannol yn y pen draw? Ac wrth siarad am ddeall ein gweithlu, mae hi'n bwysig, wrth gwrs, i mi gyfeirio hefyd at y ffaith bod TUC Cymru wedi casglu tystiolaeth yn gyson am brofiadau gweithwyr yng Nghymru am fod polisi cadarn yn dechrau gyda data cadarn, yn amlwg. Ac rwy'n credu bod rhywfaint o'r sôn o ran cyllid a phartneriaeth gymdeithasol—. Wrth gwrs, mae cyllid gan Gronfa Ddysgu Undebau Cymru yn darparu cyllid i undebau i annog a chefnogi dysgu ar safleoedd yn benodol, ac mae hynny'n ymwneud â sgiliau, ac, wrth gwrs, mae'r TUC wedi cyfeirio yn eglur iawn fod 100,000 o weithwyr yng Nghymru wedi cael mantais o ganlyniad i'r cyllid hwnnw yn ystod y blynyddoedd diwethaf.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch yn fawr. Thank you to the Member for their question. I also pay tribute to the work that she did in a previous life with TUC Cymru, doing very important work on behalf of trade unions in Wales. The focus of the question on recruitment and retention is an important one in the health service. There is work on a workforce strategy being undertaken currently, both by Welsh Government and our colleagues in Health Education and Improvement Wales. Getting these data right and planning for the long term is crucial, because we need the right staffing in the right places, with the right mix of skills, in order to deliver long-term, sustainable success for our health service.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Diolch yn fawr. Diolch i'r Aelod am ei chwestiwn. Rwy'n rhoi teyrnged iddi hefyd am y gwaith a wnaeth hi yn ei gwaith blaenorol gyda TUC Cymru, yn gwneud gwaith pwysig iawn ar ran yr undebau llafur yng Nghymru. Mae'r cwestiwn yn canolbwyntio ar recriwtio a chadw sy'n bwysig yn y gwasanaeth iechyd. Mae gwaith yn cael ei wneud ar hyn o bryd ar strategaeth gweithlu, gan Lywodraeth Cymru a'n cydweithwyr yn Addysg a Gwella Iechyd Cymru fel ei gilydd. Mae sicrhau cywirdeb y data hwn a chynllunio i'r hirdymor yn hanfodol, oherwydd mae angen y staff priodol yn y mannau priodol arnom ni, gyda'r gymysgedd gywir o sgiliau, ar gyfer cyflawni llwyddiant hirdymor, cynaliadwy i'n gwasanaeth iechyd ni.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Prynhawn da, Weinidog, a diolch hefyd i Safa am y cwestiwn.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Good afternoon, Minister, and thank you to Safa for the question.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: You said in your response to Safa that trustworthy statistics and evidence is vital to the delivery of services, but that must also include listening to residents: 9,700 people in Powys have objected to the proposals ahead of them. But I also want to talk about a recent Healthcare Inspectorate Wales—and you've talked about that body—inspection of Gwaun Cae Gurwen Surgery. It found that 85 per cent of respondents rated their experience as 'poor', while 73 per cent did not feel listened to or involved in decisions about their healthcare—a very high proportion of patients for that practice, yet the inspection did not identify failings that fully reflected the level of dissatisfaction reported by patients. We know that Healthcare Inspectorate Wales can make recommendations and seek improvements, but there are questions about how much leverage sits behind those recommendations when services fail to improve. So, Minister, I really want to hear this answer—an answer, please: for more effective—
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Roeddech chi'n dweud yn eich ymateb i Safa fod ystadegau a thystiolaeth ddibynadwy yn hanfodol wrth ddarparu gwasanaethau, ond mae'n rhaid i hynny gynnwys gwrando ar drigolion hefyd: mae 9,700 o bobl ym Mhowys wedi gwrthwynebu'r cynigion sydd o'u blaenau nhw. Ond rwy'n awyddus i siarad hefyd am arolygiad diweddar gan Arolygiaeth Gofal Iechyd Cymru—ac rydych chi wedi sôn am y corff hwnnw—o Feddygfa Gwaun Cae Gurwen. Roedd hwnnw wedi canfod bod 85 y cant o'r ymatebwyr yn ystyried eu profiad yn un 'gwael', wrth i 73 y cant fod o'r farn nad oedd neb yn gwrando arnyn nhw nac oedden nhw'n cael cyfrannu at y penderfyniadau am eu gofal iechyd—cyfran uchel iawn o gleifion ar gyfer y feddygfa honno, ac eto nid oedd yr arolygiad yn nodi methiannau a oedd yn adlewyrchu cyfradd yr anfodlonrwydd a adroddwyd gan gleifion yn llawn. Fe wyddom ni y gall Arolygiaeth Gofal Iechyd Cymru wneud argymhellion a cheisio gwelliannau, ond mae yna gwestiynau ynglŷn â faint o ddylanwad sydd gan yr argymhellion hynny pan fo gwasanaethau yn methu â gwella. Felly, Weinidog, fe hoffwn yn fawr iawn glywed yr ateb hwn—ateb, os gwelwch yn dda: i wneud penderfyniadau mwy effeithiol—

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Cwestiwn, plis. [Anghlywadwy.]
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: A question, please. [Inaudible.]

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Yes, well, I'm pre-empting it. [Laughter.] For more effective public sector decision making, who has the power to ensure that clear evidence of poor service actually results in action?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Ie, wel, rwy'n achub y blaen ar hwnnw. [Chwerthin.] I wneud penderfyniadau mwy effeithiol yn y sector cyhoeddus, pwy sydd â'r pŵer i sicrhau bod tystiolaeth eglur o wasanaeth sâl yn arwain at gamau gwirioneddol?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
I thank the Member for the question and for highlighting some of those very local issues. Clearly, I'm not abreast of the precise nature of the issues in Gwaun Cae Gurwen, but if the Member would like to write to myself or my Cabinet colleague the Cabinet Minister for health, I'm sure we can look specifically at that.

I think there is a broader question here about how Government listens, takes concerns on board and what those avenues are for citizens right across the country to make progress when those concerns are not being listened to. We've heard various examples over the last hour or so from colleagues across this Chamber. It is something that we need to be clear about, and there is almost certainly a case for ensuring that that is as effective as possible, and it's one of those areas I'd be happy to look at.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Rwy'n diolch i'r Aelod am y cwestiwn ac am dynnu sylw at rai o'r materion lleol iawn hynny. Yn amlwg, nid wyf i'n ymwybodol o natur fanwl y materion yng Ngwaun Cae Gurwen, ond pe byddai'r Aelod yn dymuno ysgrifennu ataf i neu fy nghyd-Weinidog yn y Cabinet, y Gweinidog Cabinet dros iechyd, rwy'n siŵr y gallem ni edrych ar hwnnw'n benodol.

Rwy'n credu bod cwestiwn ehangach yma ynglŷn â sut y bydd Llywodraeth yn gwrando, yn deall pryderon a pha lwybrau sydd ar gael i ddinasyddion ledled y wlad ar gyfer gwneud cynnydd pan nad yw'r pryderon hynny yn cael eu clywed. Fe glywsom ni am enghreifftiau amrywiol dros yr awr ddiwethaf oddi wrth gyd-Aelodau ar draws y Siambr hon. Mae hyn yn rhywbeth y mae angen i ni fod yn eglur iawn amdano a bron yn sicr, mae yna achos dros sicrhau bod hynny mor effeithiol â phosibl, a dyma un o'r meysydd hynny y byddwn i'n hapus i'w ystyried.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Caffael Lleol
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Local Procurement

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: 4. Pa drafodaethau y mae'r Gweinidog Cabinet wedi'u cael gyda Gweinidog y Cabinet dros Gyllid ynglŷn â chyflawni blaenoriaeth y Llywodraeth o weithio i wella lefelau caffael lleol? OQ64638
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: 4. What discussions has the Cabinet Minister had with the Cabinet Minister for Finance about delivering the Government's priority of working to improve levels of local procurement? OQ64638

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: I have regular discussions with the Cabinet Minister for Finance on public procurement and its contribution to the Welsh economy. These discussions have included strengthening Welsh supply chains, improving access to opportunities for Welsh businesses, particularly small and medium-sized enterprises and social enterprises, and increasing expenditure with Wales-based suppliers towards our 70 per cent ambition.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Rwy'n cael trafodaethau rheolaidd gyda'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Gyllid ar gaffael cyhoeddus a chyfraniad hynny i economi Cymru. Mae'r trafodaethau hyn wedi cynnwys cryfhau cadwyni cyflenwi Cymru, gwella mynediad at gyfleoedd ar gyfer busnesau Cymru, yn enwedig busnesau bach a chanolig a mentrau cymdeithasol, a chynyddu gwariant gyda chyflenwyr yng Nghymru i anelu at ein huchelgais ni o 70 y cant.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Thank you. I understand the importance of small businesses across the region being offered the opportunity to grow. Such growth in small businesses is critical to Wales for expanding employment opportunities and in terms of improving their productivity. I see local procurement as one such area of opportunity we should be encouraging and supporting. Therefore, how is your department tracking data to ensure that small and medium-sized businesses are successfully winning local contracts?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Diolch i chi. Rwy'n deall pa mor bwysig yw hi i estyn cyfleoedd i fusnesau bach ledled y rhanbarth er mwyn iddyn nhw dyfu. Mae twf o'r fath ymhlith busnesau bach yn hanfodol i Gymru ar gyfer ehangu cyfleoedd cyflogaeth ac o ran gwella eu cynhyrchiant. Rwy'n ystyried caffael lleol yn un o'r meysydd hyn ar gyfer estyn cyfleoedd y dylem ni fod yn eu hannog a'u cefnogi. Felly, sut mae eich adran chi'n olrhain data i sicrhau bod busnesau bach a chanolig yn llwyddiannus wrth ennill contractau lleol?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: I thank the Member for the question. The point is very well made. We need to support our small and medium-sized enterprises, and in my view, we can do more as a Government to support those small and medium-sized enterprises. We track supplier and contract award data through our procurement systems and business intelligence reporting and supplier information, including SME status where available, is drawn from core procurement platforms and analysed through departmental dashboards. And what this enables us to do is monitor the participation and success of SMEs in winning contracts, assess trends over time and identify opportunities to increase access to public sector procurement for local businesses.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Rwy'n diolch i'r Aelod am y cwestiwn. Cafodd y pwynt ei wneud yn dda iawn. Mae angen i ni gefnogi ein mentrau bach a chanolig, ac yn fy marn i, fe allwn ni wneud mwy yn y Llywodraeth i gefnogi'r mentrau bach a chanolig hynny. Rydym ni'n olrhain data cyflenwyr a dyfarniad contractau trwy ein systemau caffael ac mae adroddiadau deallusrwydd busnes a gwybodaeth am gyflenwyr, gan gynnwys statws BBaCh pan fo hwnnw ar gael, yn cael eu tynnu o lwyfannau caffael craidd ac yn cael eu dadansoddi drwy ddangosfyrddau adrannol. A'r hyn y mae hynny'n ein galluogi ni i'w wneud yw monitro cyfranogiad a llwyddiant busnesau bach a chanolig wrth ennill contractau, asesu tueddiadau dros amser a nodi'r cyfleoedd i fusnesau lleol ar gyfer ehangu mynediad at gaffael sector cyhoeddus.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: 9. What action is the Cabinet Minister taking to ensure that the Government is able to deliver its priorities for the people of Wales? OQ64613

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Presiding Officer, I understand that you have given your permission for questions 5 and 9 to be grouped.

In my role, I am focused on strengthening delivery across Government. Through our programme for government, we have set clear priorities. I am working to keep our efforts focused on those priorities, support joined-up working and maintain a clear focus on outcomes.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Lywydd, rwy'n deall eich bod chi wedi rhoi eich caniatâd i gwestiynau 5 a 9 gael eu grwpio gyda'i gilydd.

Yn fy swydd i, rwy'n canolbwyntio ar rymuso cyflawni ar draws y Llywodraeth. Trwy ein rhaglen lywodraethu ni, rydym ni wedi pennu blaenoriaethau amlwg. Rwy'n gweithio i ganolbwyntio ein hymdrechion yn barhaus ar y blaenoriaethau hynny, a chefnogi gweithio cydgysylltiedig, a pharhau i ganolbwyntio yn bendant ar ganlyniadau.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Thank you, Minister. You highlighted there your priorities for delivery. During the election campaign, the now First Minister signed a letter that has been quoted many times in this Chamber regarding the health visitors' dispute in the Cwm Taf health board area. The key line in that letter was:

'upgrade all Band 6 health visitors to Band 7'.

There's no ambiguity there. The First Minister put his name to that letter. How are you getting on in delivering that pledge, or wasn't it a pledge, and it was misleading in its kindest form and an outright lie in its cruellest form?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Diolch i chi, Weinidog. Roeddech chi'n tynnu sylw at eich blaenoriaethau chi ar gyfer cyflawni. Yn ystod yr ymgyrch etholiadol, fe roddodd y Prif Weinidog erbyn hyn ei lofnod ar lythyr a gafodd ei ddyfynnu sawl gwaith yn y Siambr hon ynglŷn ag anghydfod yr ymwelwyr iechyd yn ardal bwrdd iechyd Cwm Taf. Y llinell allweddol yn y llythyr hwnnw oedd:

'uwchraddio pob ymwelydd iechyd Band 6 i Fand 7'.

Nid oes unrhyw amwysedd yn hynny. Fe roddodd y Prif Weinidog ei enw ar y llythyr hwnnw. Sut ydych chi'n llwyddo wrth gyflawni'r addewid hwnnw, neu os nad addewid oedd hwnnw, roedd hynny'n gamarweiniol ar y gorau ac yn gelwydd noeth ar y gwaethaf?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: I think Members should be very careful in this Chamber of accusing colleagues of misleading the Chamber or—
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Rwy'n credu y dylai Aelodau fod yn ofalus iawn yn y Siambr hon o ran cyhuddo cyd-Aelodau o gamarwain y Siambr neu—

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Well, have you delivered it?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Wel, a ydych chi wedi cyflawni hynny?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: —misleading people. Our manifesto in the election, upon which we stood, upon which we fought the election and won the election, was based on prioritising bringing waiting lists down, on tackling waiting lists, prioritising the health service and developing productivity within the NHS. That is our priority and I will remain focused on that priority.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: —gamarwain pobl. Roedd ein maniffesto ni yn yr etholiad, yr oeddem ni'n sefyll arno, y gwnaethom ni ymladd yr etholiad ac ennill yr etholiad arno, yn seiliedig ar flaenoriaethu byrhau rhestrau aros, ar fynd i'r afael â rhestrau aros, blaenoriaethu'r gwasanaeth iechyd a datblygu cynhyrchiant yn y GIG. Honno yw ein blaenoriaeth ni ac fe fyddaf i'n dal ati i ganolbwyntio ar y flaenoriaeth honno.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Cabinet Secretary, before entering this Senedd, I served our communities as a police officer, a teacher and I worked in the NHS. And I now see daily the immense pressures on hospitals, care homes, schools, businesses and front-line staff, especially in my constituency of Fflint Wrecsam. Our communities are closely linked, as you know, with Chester, Merseyside and the wider north-west, and people want practical improvements, not further constitutional distraction. Can you explain how this Government can claim to be effective if time and civil service capacity are spent pursuing constitutional ambitions while front-line public services remain under so much pressure in the area? Thank you.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Ysgrifennydd Cabinet, cyn dod i'r Senedd hon, fe fues i'n rhoi gwasanaeth i'n cymunedau ni fel swyddog yn yr heddlu, yn athro ac fe fues i'n gweithio yn y GIG. Ac rwy'n gweld y pwysau aruthrol ar ysbytai, ar gartrefi gofal, ar ysgolion, busnesau a staff rheng flaen bob dydd, yn enwedig yn fy etholaeth i, sef Fflint Wrecsam. Mae yna gysylltiad clòs, fel gwyddoch chi, rhwng ein cymunedau ni â Chaer, Glannau Mersi a gogledd-orllewin Lloegr yn fwy eang, ac mae pobl yn dymuno cael gwelliannau ymarferol, ac nid materion cyfansoddiadol pellach sy'n tynnu sylw oddi ar hynny. A wnewch chi esbonio sut y gall y Llywodraeth hon honni bod yn effeithiol os bydd amser a gallu'r gwasanaeth sifil yn cael eu defnyddio ar gyfer mynd ar ôl uchelgeisiau cyfansoddiadol wrth i wasanaethau cyhoeddus rheng flaen barhau i fod dan gymaint o straen yn yr ardal? Diolch i chi.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Thank you to the Member, and I'm very well aware of those thriving and important cross-border relationships in the north-east to the north-west of England, and also in the south-east to the south-west of England, and we support those important relationships.

I think the broader question relating to Government priorities is very clear in my mind. Our priorities are childcare, child poverty, the health service, schools and the economy. And on each of those, we intend to make progress. As the Cabinet Minister for the constitution, specifically charged with looking at constitutional issues, there are a range of areas—railways, the Crown Estate, policing—where I believe we can make progress, working with the UK Government, to deliver better services for people in Wales. And that remains the core focus of my work as a Government Minister and a core focus of our work as a Welsh Government—delivering better public services, whether it's in schools, health or education.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Diolch i'r Aelod, ac rwy'n ymwybodol iawn o'r berthynas drawsffiniol ffyniannus a phwysig sy'n bodoli rhwng gogledd-ddwyrain Cymru a gogledd-orllewin Lloegr, ac sydd hefyd rhwng de-ddwyrain Cymru a de-orllewin Lloegr, ac rydym ni'n gefnogol iawn i'r cysylltiadau pwysig hynny i gyd.

Rwy'n credu bod y cwestiwn ehangach sy'n ymwneud â blaenoriaethau'r Llywodraeth yn eglur iawn yn fy marn i. Ein blaenoriaethau ni yw gofal plant, tlodi plant, y gwasanaeth iechyd, ysgolion a'r economi. Ac o ran pob un o'r rhain, rydym ni'n bwriadu gwneud cynnydd. Yn Weinidog Cabinet dros y cyfansoddiad, sy'n gyfrifol am edrych ar faterion cyfansoddiadol yn benodol, mae yna amrywiaeth o feysydd—rheilffyrdd, Ystad y Goron, plismona—lle gallwn ni wneud cynnydd, yn fy marn i, gan weithio gyda Llywodraeth y DU, er mwyn darparu gwasanaethau gwell i bobl yng Nghymru. Ac mae hynny'n dal i fod yn greiddiol ac yn ganolbwynt i'm gwaith i'n Weinidog y Llywodraeth ac yn ganolog i ni yn Llywodraeth Cymru—gan ddarparu gwasanaethau cyhoeddus gwell, boed hynny o ran ysgolion, iechyd neu addysg.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Diolch, Weinidog Cabinet. O ofal plant i gyfraddau busnes a chymorth efo costau byw, mae'r Llywodraeth yn mynd i'r afael â'r problemau sy'n effeithio ar bobl hyd a lled Cymru. Dwi'n falch o'n gweld ni'n cydweithio ar draws gwahanol bortffolios a lleihau'r gweithio sy'n cymryd lle mewn seilos llywodraethol—rhywbeth dŷn ni wedi'i eisiau ers blynyddoedd maith.

Nawr, fel y nodwyd ar ôl y 100 diwrnod, mae'r Llywodraeth yn buddsoddi £100 miliwn i daclo rhestrau aros y GIG. Mae'n hynod o bwysig i bobl ar draws Cymru, ac, wrth gwrs, yng Ngŵyr Abertawe, fod y Llywodraeth yn llwyddo i fynd i'r afael â'r broblem fawr hon, sydd wedi wynebu Cymru ers llawer rhy hir. Sut bydd y Llywodraeth yn sicrhau bod buddsoddiadau fel hyn yn darparu'r budd mwyaf effeithiol, ac, yn fwy pwysig, parhaol, wrth gyflwyno'r rhaglen lywodraethu? Diolch yn fawr.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Thank you, Cabinet Minister. From childcare to business rates and support with the cost of living, this Government is already tackling the issues affecting people across Wales. I'm pleased to see us collaborating across different portfolios and reducing the work carried out in Government silos, which is something that has been needed for many years.

Now, as noted after the first 100 days, the Government is investing £100 million in tackling waiting lists in the NHS. It's vital for people across Wales, and, of course, in Gŵyr Abertawe, that the Government succeeds in tackling this huge problem, which has faced Wales for far too long. How will the Government ensure that these investments will provide the most effective, and, more importantly, continuous benefit, while delivering the programme for government? Thank you.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Wel, diolch yn fawr i'r Aelod am y cwestiwn, a dwi'n gwybod bod yntau wedi gwasanaethu'r NHS am flynyddoedd lawer, ac yn effeithiol iawn, yn Abertawe. Mae yna graidd i'r cwestiynau yma, onid oes, sef, gyda'r buddsoddiad ychwanegol mae'r Llywodraeth yma yn ei roi yng ngofal plant, yn y gwasanaeth iechyd, yn yr economi, mae angen canlyniadau i bobl. Ac felly, mae angen edrych yn fanwl iawn, fel mae'n cyfaill y Gweinidog Cabinet dros iechyd wedi'i wneud, ar beth yn union yw'r cynlluniau. Ydyn nhw'n gynlluniau sy'n mynd i ddelifro i'r tymor hir? Ydyn nhw'n sicrhau bod yna gydweithio rhwng y gwasanaeth iechyd a'r gwasanaeth gofal trwy awdurdodau lleol i sicrhau bod y pecyn gofal yn gyflawn, i sicrhau bod rhai o'r heriau sydd yn y system yn cael eu hannerch? Ydyn nhw'n edrych, fel y gwnaeth fy nghydweithwraig gynnau fach gyfeirio atyn nhw, i'r hirdymor gyda'r gweithlu? Mae'r holl faterion yna'n gorfod dod at ei gilydd, a gofyn y cwestiwn bob tro: ydy'r arian yma yn mynd i wneud newid go iawn yn yr hirdymor, nid jest am y tymor byr? Diolch yn fawr.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Well, I thank the Member very much for the question, and I know that he has served the NHS for many years, and very effectively, in Swansea. There is a common theme to these questions, isn't there, that, with this additional funding that the Government's providing in childcare, in the health service, in the economy, we need outcomes for the people of Wales. And therefore, we need to look in great detail, as my colleague the Cabinet Minister for health has done, at what exactly those plans are. Are they plans that will deliver for the longer term? Do they ensure that there is collaboration between the health service and the care service provided through local authorities in order to ensure that the care package is complete, to ensure that some of the challenges in the system are addressed? Do they look, as our colleague earlier referred to, to the longer term with the workforce? So, all of those issues have to coalesce, and we always have to ask the question as to whether this money is going to deliver real change in the long term, not just in the short term. Thank you.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch. Cyn symud ymlaen i'r cwestiwn nesaf—
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Thank you. Before moving on to the next question—

There are points of debate, but we have ways of debating this within the Chamber. It's not aimed at anybody in particular. In the generality, please, abide by that.

Mae yna bwyntiau dadl, ond mae gennym ffyrdd o drafod hyn o fewn y Siambr. Nid yw wedi'i anelu at unrhyw un yn benodol. Sylwadau cyffredinol, os gwelwch yn dda, cadwch at hynny.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: 6. Pa asesiad y mae Llywodraeth Cymru wedi'i wneud o'r angen am Ddeddf Cymru newydd i sicrhau pwerau sy'n gyfartal â'r Alban? OQ64630
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: 6. What assessment has the Welsh Government made of the need for a new Wales Act to ensure equality of powers with Scotland? OQ64630

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Ein hasesiad ni yw y dylai Cymru gael y pwerau sydd eu hangen i gyflawni dros bobl Cymru, gwella gwasanaethau a chryfhau atebolrwydd. Rŷn ni yn pwyso am setliad tecach i Gymru. Byddai Bil Cymru newydd yn darparu'r ffordd gliriaf a mwyaf effeithiol o wneud y newidiadau y cytunir arnynt.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Our assessment is that Wales should have the powers that it needs to deliver for the people of Wales, improve services and strengthen accountability. We are pressing for a fairer settlement for Wales. A new Wales Bill would provide the clearest way and the most effective way of implementing agreed changes.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch am yr ymateb. Mae'r setliad datganoli presennol yng Nghymru yn ein gadael ni'n fyr o nifer o'r pwerau a'r hyblygrwydd sydd eu hangen arnom fel cenedl i lunio a gweithredu polisïau trawsadrannol, cydlynol er lles ein cymunedau. Roeddwn i'n falch iawn o glywed Prif Weinidog Cymru yn cyhoeddi'r wythnos diwethaf ei fod wedi ysgrifennu at Brif Weinidog y Deyrnas Unedig yn ffurfiol i geisio sicrhau bargen newydd i Gymru, bargen fyddai'n trosglwyddo nifer o'r pwerau sydd eisoes wedi'u datganoli i'r Alban, megis plismona, cyfiawnder, Ystad y Goron, rheilffyrdd, lles a thegwch ariannol. Mae nifer o gomisiynau annibynnol dros y blynyddoedd, gan gynnwys comisiwn Silk a'r Comisiwn Annibynnol ar Ddyfodol Cyfansoddiadol Cymru, wedi dod i'r casgliad bod angen cryfhau datganoli a rhoi mwy o bwerau yn nwylo'r Senedd er mwyn galluogi Cymru i fynd i'r afael yn fwy effeithiol â'u heriau ei hun. Gyda hynny mewn golwg, a wnaiff y Gweinidog Cabinet ymrwymo i barhau i bwyso ar Lywodraeth y Deyrnas Unedig? O'r diwedd—
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Thank you for that response. The current devolution settlement in Wales leaves us short of many of the powers and the flexibility that we need as a nation to formulate and implement coherent cross-departmental policies for the benefit of our communities. I was very pleased to hear the First Minister of Wales announce last week that he had written to the UK Prime Minister formally to try to secure a new deal for Wales, a deal that would transfer a number of powers that have already been devolved to Scotland, such as policing, justice, the Crown Estate, railways, welfare and fiscal fairness. A number of independent commissions and reviews over the years, including the Silk commission and the Independent Commission on the Constitutional Future of Wales, have come to the conclusion that devolution needs to be strengthened and more powers placed in the hands of the Senedd in order to allow Wales to deal more effectively with its own challenges. With that in mind, will the Cabinet Minister commit to continuing to press the UK Government? Finally—

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch yn fawr. Dwi'n credu bod yr Aelod yn gofyn i fi ymrwymo i bwyso ar Lywodraeth Prydain i sicrhau cynnydd. Dwi'n gwneud yr ymrwymiad hwnnw yn glir ac yn hapus. Dwi'n credu ei bod hi'n werth adrodd wrth y Senedd fod fy nghyfarfodydd cychwynnol i gyda Gweinidogion Cabinet o Lywodraeth Prydain wedi bod yn adeiladol ac yn gydweithredol. Wrth gwrs, wrth i'r trafodaethau fynd yn eu blaen, fe ddown ni i mewn i'r manylion. Ond dwi yn awyddus i bwysleisio bod yr ymateb sydd wedi dod hyd yn hyn wedi bod yn gadarnhaol, ac felly dwi'n gobeithio y bydd hynny yn sail i gynnydd pellach.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Thank you. I believe the Member is asking me to commit to press the UK Government to secure progress. I make that clear commitment this afternoon, and I do so happily. I think it's worth reporting to the Senedd that my initial meetings with UK Cabinet Ministers have been constructive and collaborative. Of course, as the discussions develop, we will get into the minutiae. But I am eager to emphasise that the response that I've received to date has been positive, and I therefore hope that that will be the basis for further progress.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: The Welsh Government will work closely with partners at a local and regional level to ensure that decision making and service delivery take place in ways that support effective delivery of public services.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Bydd Llywodraeth Cymru yn gweithio'n agos gyda phartneriaid ar lefel leol a rhanbarthol i sicrhau bod gwneud penderfyniadau a darparu gwasanaethau yn digwydd mewn ffyrdd sy'n cefnogi'r ddarpariaeth o wasanaethau cyhoeddus yn effeithiol.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Thank you for that answer. Andy Burnham, the new Prime Minister, of course, has set out his ambition to rewire the state. It's quite clear to me and many people in Wales that we need to rewire Wales in order to make sure that people in their communities have a greater opportunity to shape the decisions that are made about those communities by politicians at all levels. One of the ways to do that is to make politicians more accountable to the citizens that they serve. What action is the Welsh Government going to take to address the accountability gap created by the new Senedd election system, which, I'm afraid, the way that it is at the moment, does not give an opportunity for individual members of the public to demonstrate their support for an individual candidate, rather than a political party?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Diolch am yr ateb yna. Mae Andy Burnham, y Prif Weinidog newydd, wrth gwrs, wedi nodi ei uchelgais i ailweirio'r wladwriaeth. Mae'n eithaf amlwg i mi a llawer o bobl yng Nghymru bod angen i ni ailweirio Cymru er mwyn sicrhau bod pobl yn eu cymunedau yn cael mwy o gyfle i lunio'r penderfyniadau sy'n cael eu gwneud am y cymunedau hynny gan wleidyddion ar bob lefel. Un o'r ffyrdd o wneud hynny yw gwneud gwleidyddion yn fwy atebol i'r dinasyddion y maent yn eu gwasanaethu. Pa gamau y mae Llywodraeth Cymru yn mynd i'w cymryd i fynd i'r afael â'r bwlch atebolrwydd a grëwyd gan system etholiadol newydd y Senedd, nad yw, rwy'n ofni, fel y mae ar hyn o bryd, yn rhoi cyfle i aelodau unigol o'r cyhoedd ddangos eu cefnogaeth i ymgeisydd unigol, yn hytrach nag i blaid wleidyddol?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Well, I'm delighted to see that the Welsh Conservatives are now in favour of the single transferrable vote. I should encourage everyone—[Interruption.] I should encourage everyone in this—[Interruption.] Well, that is the best way—[Interruption.] That is the best way—[Interruption.] That is the best way to ensure effective accountability, and I hope in due course that every Member of the Senedd will support such a development of the Welsh electoral system.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Wel, rwy'n falch iawn o weld bod y Ceidwadwyr Cymreig bellach o blaid yr un bleidlais drosglwyddadwy. Dylwn annog pawb—[Torri ar draws.] Dylwn annog pawb yn—[Torri ar draws.] Wel, dyna'r ffordd orau—[Torri ar draws.] Dyna'r ffordd orau—[Torri ar draws.] Dyna'r ffordd orau i sicrhau atebolrwydd effeithiol, ac rwy'n gobeithio maes o law y bydd pob Aelod o'r Senedd yn cefnogi datblygiad o'r fath yn system etholiadol Cymru.
