XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Mae'r heriau mwyaf sy'n wynebu Cymru yn galw am ymateb ar draws y Llywodraeth gyfan. Dyna pam mae ein rhaglen lywodraethu yn nodi uchelgais newydd i Gymru, wedi'i seilio ar flaenoriaethau a rennir yn hytrach nag ar seilos adrannol. Dwi'n gweithio'n agos iawn gyda chydweithwyr reit ar draws y Cabinet i sicrhau bod y Llywodraeth yn cydweithio ar draws portffolios er mwyn sicrhau canlyniadau ystyrlon i bobl ledled Cymru.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: The greatest challenges facing Wales demand a whole-Government response. That is why our programme for government sets out a new ambition for Wales, based on shared priorities rather than departmental silos. I work closely with colleagues right across the Cabinet to ensure that the Government collaborates across portfolios to ensure meaningful outcomes for people across Wales.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch, Weinidog. Roeddwn i'n falch iawn o arwain dadl yn y Siambr hon am yr angen i integreiddio'r gwaith o atal ACEs, neu adverse childhood experiences, ac ymateb iddynt ar draws gwasanaethau cyhoeddus. Nid yw profiad plentyn neu berson o drawma yn parchu ffiniau adrannol. Gall tai, addysg, iechyd, gofal cymdeithasol a chyflogaeth oll chwarae rhan mewn creu amodau ble mae plant a theuluoedd yn adfer o drawma ac yn ffynnu. A wnewch chi felly amlinellu sut y bydd y Llywodraeth yn helpu i sicrhau bod trawma a phrofiadau niweidiol yn ystod plentyndod, ACEs, yn cael sylw ar draws y Llywodraeth, yn hytrach nag fel mater i adrannau unigol?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Thank you, Minister. I was delighted to lead a debate in this Chamber on the need to integrate the work of preventing ACEs, or adverse childhood experiences, and respond to them across public services. The experience of a child or a person of trauma doesn't respect departmental boundaries. Housing, health, education, social care and employment can all play their part in creating conditions where children and families recover from trauma and prosper. Will you therefore outline how the Government will help to ensure that trauma and adverse experiences during childhood, or ACEs, are covered across Government, rather than as an issue for individual departments?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Diolch yn fawr iawn i'r Aelod am y cwestiwn, a dwi'n talu teyrnged i'r gwaith mae hi wedi'i wneud, ac eraill yn y Siambr hon, ar sail drawsbleidiol, i ddatblygu ein dealltwriaeth ni o'r effaith mae trawma yn ei gael ar blant ac, yn wir, ar y sawl sy'n oedolion sydd wedi profi trawma yn blant. Trwy fframwaith Cymru sy'n ystyriol o drawma, cefnogaeth Hyb ACE Cymru a chydweithio agos ar draws portffolios gweinidogol, rŷm ni'n ymgorffori dulliau sy'n ystyriol o adverse childhood experiences a thrawma ar draws datblygu polisïau a darparu gwasanaethau.

Mae atal profiadau niweidiol yn ystod plentyndod ac ymateb yn effeithiol i drawma yn gyfrifoldeb a rennir ar draws y Llywodraeth a gwasanaethau cyhoeddus. Mae'n ddull gweithredu wedi ei gynllunio i sicrhau bod y gwaith yn cael ei gydlynu, yn hytrach na'i adael i adrannau a sefydliadau unigol i weithredu ar eu pennau eu hunain. Dyna'n huchelgais, Lywydd. Fy ngobaith i fel rhan o fy rôl i yw sicrhau bod hynny'n digwydd. Mae'r uchelgais honno, sydd wedi'i rhannu gan Lywodraethau yn y gorffennol, heb o reidrwydd bob tro wedi cael ei gweithredu ar lawr gwlad, a dyna fyddwn i'n dymuno canolbwyntio arno.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
I thank the Member for the question, and I pay tribute to the work that she has carried out, and others in the Chamber, on a cross-party basis, to develop our understanding of the impact that trauma does have on children and, indeed, on adults who have experienced trauma as children. Through the trauma-informed Wales framework and the support of ACE Hub Wales and close collaboration across ministerial portfolios, we're implementing approaches informed by adverse childhood experiences and trauma across the development of policies and the provision of services.

Preventing ACEs and responding effectively to trauma is a responsibility that's shared across the Government and public services. Our approach has been planned to ensure that the work is co-ordinated, rather than left to individual organisations and departments to implement themselves. That's our ambition, Llywydd. My hope as part of my role is to ensure that that does happen. That ambition, which was shared by Governments of the past, hasn't always been implemented at grass-roots level, and that's what I would wish to focus on.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: This Government’s position is clear: policing should be fully devolved to Wales. The Dirprwy Brif Weinidog and I have met with the policing Minister to discuss devolution and other policing priorities. I've also had an introductory meeting with the Secretary of State for Wales.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Mae safbwynt y Llywodraeth hon yn glir: dylai plismona gael ei ddatganoli'n llawn i Gymru. Rwyf hefyd wedi cael cyfarfod rhagarweiniol gydag Ysgrifennydd Gwladol Cymru.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Thank you. Minister, your Government's supplementary budget was recently defeated. Your finance Minister then wrote

'we must avoid creating additional spending obligations where the funding position has yet to be agreed.'

Before seeking more policing powers, your Government should demonstrate that it can deliver with the powers it already holds. Education is devolved, yet Wales has the worst Programme for International Student Assessment scores in the United Kingdom.

Your Government is also struggling with other existing responsibilities, such as cutting NHS waiting lists. Your own statistics show that the number of pathways waiting for treatment increased between June and July, with two-year waits also rising. Those are delivery problems under responsibilities you already hold. And yet, with all these current issues the Government is struggling with, surprisingly, you seek additional devolved powers for policing. Money doesn't grow on trees, although our previous Welsh Government seemed to test that theory in Uganda. Given your record of failings, what evidence do you have that this Government can deliver if policing is devolved? Thank you.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Diolch. Weinidog, trechwyd cyllideb atodol eich Llywodraeth yn ddiweddar. Yna ysgrifennodd eich Gweinidog dros gyllid

'rhaid i ni osgoi creu rhwymedigaethau gwariant ychwanegol lle nad yw'r sefyllfa ariannu wedi'i chytuno eto.'

Cyn ceisio mwy o bwerau plismona, dylai eich Llywodraeth ddangos ei bod yn gallu cyflawni gyda'r pwerau sydd ganddi eisoes. Mae addysg wedi'i datganoli, ond Cymru sydd â sgoriau gwaethaf y Rhaglen Ryngwladol Asesu Myfyrwyr yn y Deyrnas Unedig.

Mae eich Llywodraeth hefyd yn cael trafferth gyda chyfrifoldebau presennol eraill, megis torri rhestrau aros y GIG. Mae eich ystadegau eich hun yn dangos bod nifer y llwybrau sy'n aros am driniaeth wedi cynyddu rhwng Mehefin a Gorffennaf, gydag arosiadau dwy flynedd hefyd yn cynyddu. Mae'r rhain yn broblemau cyflawni o dan gyfrifoldebau sydd gennych eisoes. Ac eto, gyda'r holl broblemau presennol hyn y mae'r Llywodraeth yn cael trafferth gyda nhw, er syndod, rydych chi'n ceisio pwerau datganoledig ychwanegol ar gyfer plismona. Nid yw arian yn tyfu ar goed, er ei bod yn ymddangos bod ein Llywodraeth flaenorol yn profi'r theori honno yn Uganda. O ystyried eich hanes o fethiannau, pa dystiolaeth sydd gennych y gall y Llywodraeth hon gyflawni os bydd plismona yn cael ei ddatganoli? Diolch.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
I thank the Member for the question. I'm not entirely sure that he is convinced of a record of failings after five months. I should probably remind him that another party was in Government for 27 years, and if he wants to address—[Interruption.] If he wants to address questions to Members of that party, I'm sure he can do so afterwards in the tea room.

Our focus as a Government is on delivery, on schools, on childcare, on child poverty, on the NHS and on the economy. We have identified that there is a programme of policing reform taking place now for the England and Wales jurisdiction, led by the Home Office. There is an opportunity there to make the case for greater devolution for Wales, for greater responsibility for the Welsh Government, which will make communities in Wales safer, and that is what we will pursue.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Diolchaf i'r Aelod am y cwestiwn. Nid wyf yn hollol siŵr ei fod yn argyhoeddedig o ran yr hanes o fethiannau ar ôl pum mis. Mae'n debyg y dylwn ei atgoffa bod plaid arall wedi Llywodraethu am 27 mlynedd, ac os yw'n dymuno cyfeirio—[Torri ar draws.] Os yw'n dymuno cyfeirio cwestiynau at Aelodau'r blaid honno, rwy'n siŵr y gall wneud hynny wedyn yn yr ystafell de.

Mae ein ffocws fel Llywodraeth ar gyflawni, ar ysgolion, ar ofal plant, ar dlodi plant, ar y GIG ac ar yr economi. Rydym wedi nodi bod rhaglen o ddiwygio plismona yn digwydd nawr ar gyfer awdurdodaeth Cymru a Lloegr, dan arweiniad y Swyddfa Gartref. Mae cyfle yno i wneud yr achos dros fwy o ddatganoli i Gymru, dros fwy o gyfrifoldeb i Lywodraeth Cymru, a fydd yn gwneud cymunedau yng Nghymru yn fwy diogel, a dyna beth y byddwn yn ei ddilyn.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: The Well‑being of Future Generations (Wales) Act 2015

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: 12. How is the Welsh Government ensuring the successful implementation of the Well‑being of Future Generations (Wales) Act 2015? OQ64623

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Mae’r rhaglen lywodraethu a'n hamcanion llesiant yn un fframwaith gweithredu sy’n cysylltu'r blaenoriaethau mae pobl wedi ymddiried ynom i’w cyflawni a’r canlyniadau hirdymor yn y Ddeddf rydym am eu cyflawni. Dwi hefyd wedi cytuno i adolygiad o'r Ddeddf, gan ganolbwyntio ar wella’r ffordd mae’r Ddeddf yn cael ei gweithredu.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: The programme for government and our well-being objectives are a single framework for action, linking the priorities people have entrusted us to deliver and the long-term outcomes of the Act that we want to achieve. I've also agreed to a review of the Act, focusing on enhancing the Act’s implementation in practice.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Weinidog, mae diwylliant wedi wynebu degawd o doriadau cyllid. Nid yw toriadau i gyllid yn effeithio ar y sector celfyddydol yn unig. Maent hefyd yn cael effaith uniongyrchol ar lesiant a bywiogrwydd cymunedau a chymdeithas Cymru. Os ydym am fod o ddifrif ynghylch Deddf llesiant cenedlaethau'r dyfodol, rhaid neilltuo a diogelu cyllid ataliol i gefnogi'r celfyddydau. Mae diwylliant yn cyfrannu'n uniongyrchol at lesiant unigolion ac at fywiogrwydd ein cymunedau ledled Cymru. Felly, sut y bydd y Gweinidog yn gweithio ar draws portffolios i sicrhau bod diwylliant yn cael ei gydnabod fel rhan annatod o iechyd ataliol ar draws y Llywodraeth?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Minister, culture has faced a decade of funding cuts. Funding cuts don't just affect the arts sector. They also have a direct impact on the well-being and vitality of Welsh communities and society. If we are serious about the well-being of future generations Act, we must ring-fence and protect preventative funding to support the arts. Culture contributes directly to the well-being of individuals and to the vitality of our communities throughout Wales. So, how will the Minister work across portfolios to ensure that culture is recognised as an integral part of preventative health across Government?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch yn fawr i'r Aelod am y cwestiwn. Mae yna ymrwymiad clir gan y Llywodraeth yma i hybu diwylliant a chwaraeon. Mae yna strategaeth diwylliant a chwaraeon newydd dan ofal y Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon a'r Trefnydd. Mae yna ffocws clir gan y Llywodraeth hon ar hybu a hyrwyddo chwaraeon a diwylliant, ond hefyd cydnabod, fel rŷch chi wedi nodi, y rôl bwysig mae diwylliant a chwaraeon yn gallu ei chael ar draws ystod polisi cyhoeddus, gan gynnwys yr agenda iechyd ataliol, sy'n bwysig iawn i'r Llywodraeth hon. Diolch yn fawr.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: I thank the Member for that question. There is a clear commitment from this Government to promote culture and sport. There is a new culture and sport strategy, which is being led by the Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport and Trefnydd. There is a clear focus from this Government on promoting sport and culture, whilst also recognising, as you have set out, the important role that culture and sport can have across a range of public policies, including the preventative health agenda, which is hugely important to this Government. Thank you.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Daeth y Dirprwy Lywydd (Kerry Ferguson) i’r Gadair.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: The Deputy Presiding Officer (Kerry Ferguson) took the Chair.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Cwestiynau i’r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a'r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Questions to the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch yn fawr i chi, Weinidog.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Thank you very much, Minister.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Member_job_title_English: Trefnydd, Chief Whip and Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Member_job_title_Welsh: Trefnydd, Prif Chwip a Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch, Ddirprwy Lywydd. Nid oes unrhyw newidiadau i fusnes yr wythnos hon. Mae busnes drafft y tair wythnos nesaf wedi'i nodi yn y datganiad busnes, sydd ar gael i holl Aelodau'n electronig.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Thank you, Dirprwy Lywydd. There are no changes to this week's business. Draft Plenary business for the next three weeks is shown on the business statement, which is available to Members electronically.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Minister, I would like an urgent statement on who is holding the Welsh Ambulance Services University NHS Trust to account for electrification and decarbonisation spending. My freedom of information request remains unanswered. Financial information requested before our future meeting is being withheld. This is public money, and that is unacceptable. Is this yet another expensive vanity project with little obvious tangible benefits to patients? Where's the funded plan? What evidence shows this spending will cut response times, deliver life-saving treatment sooner and save lives, or will this ultimately cost lives on the altar of decarbonisation? Can the Minister guarantee those improvements? If so, show the Chamber credible evidence from an independent body. If the ambulance service persists with this project, will the Minister restore the previous response time measure alongside current reporting so that the public can accurately judge performance? Saving lives must be the measure of success. Thank you.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Weinidog, hoffwn ddatganiad brys ynghylch pwy sy'n dal Ymddiriedolaeth Brifysgol GIG Gwasanaethau Ambiwlans Cymru i gyfrif am wariant trydaneiddio a datgarboneiddio. Mae fy nghais rhyddid gwybodaeth yn parhau heb ei ateb. Mae gwybodaeth ariannol y gofynnwyd amdani cyn ein cyfarfod yn y dyfodol yn cael ei gadw'n ôl. Mae hwn yn arian cyhoeddus, ac mae hynny'n annerbyniol. A yw hwn yn brosiect gwagedd drud arall heb fawr o fuddion diriaethol amlwg i gleifion? Ble mae'r cynllun a ariennir? Pa dystiolaeth sy'n dangos y bydd y gwariant hwn yn lleihau amseroedd ymateb, yn darparu triniaeth achub bywydau yn gynt ac yn achub bywydau, neu a fydd hyn yn y pen draw yn golygu aberthu bywydau ar allor datgarboneiddio? A all y Gweinidog warantu'r gwelliannau hynny? Os felly, dangoswch dystiolaeth gredadwy i'r Siambr gan gorff annibynnol. Os bydd y gwasanaeth ambiwlans yn parhau gyda'r prosiect hwn, a wnaiff y Gweinidog adfer y mesur amser ymateb blaenorol ochr yn ochr â'r adroddiadau cyfredol fel y gall y cyhoedd farnu perfformiad yn gywir? Rhaid i achub bywydau fod yn fesur llwyddiant. Diolch.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Business Statement and Announcement

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Mae yna gwestiynau i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Iechyd a Gofal yfory, felly fe fyddai'n briodol i chi fod yn codi'r rhain yn ystod y sesiwn honno. Os na fydd yna gyfle, mi fuaswn i'n awgrymu eich bod chi'n ysgrifennu gyda'ch holl gwestiynau at y Gweinidog yn uniongyrchol.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: There are questions to the Cabinet Minister for Health and Care tomorrow, so it would be appropriate for you to raise them tomorrow during that session. If there's no opportunity to do that, I would suggest that you write with all of your questions to the Minister directly.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Could I ask for a statement from the Government updating us on the work on the fire summit, please? I know that there was a very clear consensus in the Chamber when we had the statement from the First Minister that there should be involvement of those who worked at a grass-roots level—so, farmers and others who supported the firefighters in their efforts. I was concerned to see that, of the representatives from Blaenavon, just one has been included. Indeed, one of the key landowners has actually been uninvited. I'm also informed that the summit is only going to be for two hours. I would question whether that will be enough to deal with something as significant as this. So, could I ask the Trefnydd whether we could have an update on this?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: A gaf i ofyn am ddatganiad gan y Llywodraeth yn rhoi'r wybodaeth ddiweddaraf i ni ynghylch y gwaith ar yr uwchgynhadledd tân, os gwelwch yn dda? Rwy'n gwybod bod consensws clir iawn yn y Siambr pan gawsom y datganiad gan y Prif Weinidog y dylid cynnwys y rhai a weithiodd ar lawr gwlad—felly, ffermwyr ac eraill a gefnogodd y diffoddwyr tân yn eu hymdrechion. Roeddwn i'n bryderus o weld mai dim ond un o'r cynrychiolwyr o Flaenafon sydd wedi'i gynnwys. Yn wir, mae un o'r tirfeddianwyr allweddol heb gael gwahoddiad mewn gwirionedd. Rwyf wedi cael gwybod hefyd mai dim ond am ddwy awr y bydd yr uwchgynhadledd yn para. Byddwn yn cwestiynu a fydd hynny'n ddigon i ymdrin â rhywbeth mor arwyddocaol â hyn. Felly, a gaf i ofyn i'r Trefnydd a allwn gael diweddariad ynghylch hyn?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch i chi am godi'r materion hynny. Mi fyddwch chi wedi clywed y Prif Weinidog yn gyfan gwbl ddiamwys o ran ymroddiad y Llywodraeth hon i fod yn edrych a dysgu'r gwersi angenrheidiol o hynny. Mi fyddwch chi'n gwybod hefyd trefn busnes y Senedd hon. Gyda'r pryderon rydych chi'n eu codi, mi fuaswn yn awgrymu mai ysgrifennu at y Prif Weinidog fyddai orau, gan fod yna bethau penodol iawn rydych chi wedi'u codi. Rwy'n credu, o edrych ar y rhaglen fusnes, ei bod hi'n bosibl na fydd lle am nifer o wythnosau am ddatganiad o'r fath, ac mae'r hyn rydych chi wedi'i godi yn awgrymu bod angen ateb arnoch yn gynt na hynny. Yn amlwg, rydyn ni wedi ymrwymo i barhau i ddiweddaru'r Senedd hon ac i ymwneud â phob Aelod ar y mater hollbwysig hwn.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Thank you for raising those issues. You will have heard the First Minister stating unambiguously the commitment of this Government to look at and learn the necessary lessons from those experiences. You will also know the order of business in this Senedd. With the concerns that you expresses, I would suggest that writing to the First Minister would be best, because they were very specific issues that you raised. I think, in looking at the business programme, perhaps there wouldn't be space for such a statement for a number of weeks, whereas the issues that you have raised suggest that you need an answer sooner than that. Clearly, we are committed to continuing to update this Senedd and we will do so with all Members on this crucial issue.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Trefnydd, I'd like to request a statement from the Cabinet Minister for Enterprise, Connectivity and Energy on the announcement that Milford Haven's Impala terminal is to cease its commercial operations at the end of this year. We must fully understand the implications of this announcement, including the scale of any job losses and the impact on the local economy. We also need further clarity on how the Welsh Government intends to support both the company and its workforce as this situation develops. These are highly skilled and valuable jobs, and every effort must be made to retain this expertise within the region and to safeguard future employment opportunities. In my view, losing such skills would be a significant blow to the local economy and, indeed, to the wider energy sector. Therefore, I'd be grateful if the Welsh Government could provide an urgent statement outlining its engagement with the company to date, the discussions it has held regarding the future of the terminal and the support that may be available to both the workforce and the operator, going forward.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Drefnydd, hoffwn ofyn am ddatganiad gan Weinidog y Cabinet dros Fenter, Cysylltedd ac Ynni ar y cyhoeddiad bod terfynfa Impala Aberdaugleddau yn rhoi'r gorau i'w gweithrediadau masnachol ddiwedd eleni. Rhaid i ni ddeall goblygiadau'r cyhoeddiad hwn yn llawn, gan gynnwys graddfa unrhyw golled o swyddi a'r effaith ar yr economi leol. Mae angen eglurder pellach arnom hefyd ynghylch sut mae Llywodraeth Cymru yn bwriadu cefnogi'r cwmni a'i weithlu wrth i'r sefyllfa hon ddatblygu. Mae'r rhain yn swyddi hynod fedrus a gwerthfawr, a rhaid gwneud pob ymdrech i gadw'r arbenigedd hwn yn y rhanbarth ac i ddiogelu cyfleoedd cyflogaeth yn y dyfodol. Yn fy marn i, byddai colli sgiliau o'r fath yn ergyd sylweddol i'r economi leol ac, yn wir, i'r sector ynni ehangach. Felly, byddwn yn ddiolchgar pe bai Llywodraeth Cymru yn gallu darparu datganiad brys yn amlinellu ei hymgysylltiad â'r cwmni hyd yma, y trafodaethau y mae wedi'u cynnal ynghylch dyfodol y derfynfa a'r gefnogaeth a allai fod ar gael i'r gweithlu a'r gweithredwr, yn y dyfodol.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch i'r Aelod am godi mater rwy'n gwybod sy'n pryderu nifer fawr o Aelodau yn sgil y newyddion hwn, ac rwy'n gwybod bod y Llywodraeth mewn trafodaethau â'r cwmni i ddeall beth ydy goblygiadau hyn. Dwi'n deall hefyd fod yna gwestiwn amserol ar y pwnc hwn a fydd yn fater, wrth gwrs, i'r Llywydd a'r Dirprwy Lywydd ei ystyried. Yn sicr, rydyn ni'n siomedig dros ben o glywed y newyddion hwn. Dwi'n gwybod y bydd hyn yn creu pryder aruthrol yn lleol ac i'r rheini sydd yn wynebu ansicrwydd, ynghyd â'r gymuned ehangach. Felly, rwy'n rhoi'r sicrwydd hwnnw i'r Aelod fod y trafodaethau hynny â'r Llywodraeth yn parhau, ac yn sicr mi fyddaf yn sicrhau bod y Gweinidog Cabinet yn gwybod eich bod chi wedi codi'r mater pwysig hwn gyda mi heddiw.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: I thank the Member for raising an important matter that I know is of great concern to Members in the wake of this news, and I know that the Government is in discussions with the company to understand what the implications are. I also understand that there is a topical question on this issue, which will be a matter for the Llywydd and Dirprwy Lywydd to consider. Certainly, we are very disappointed to hear this news. I know that this will create great concern locally and for those who face uncertainty in the broader community. So, I can provide that assurance to the Member that those discussions with the Government and the company are continuing and, certainly, I will ensure that the Cabinet Minister knows that you have raised this important issue today.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Trefnydd, could I request an urgent statement from the Cabinet Minister for Health and Care regarding the reported outbreak of scabies in the Hywel Dda health board area, and the adequacy of the Welsh Government's response to this developing public health concern? There is growing concern about the spread of scabies within communities and care settings. The situation has become even more alarming following the reported death of an elderly gentleman, whose illness was linked to complications associated with scabies. Given the vulnerability of older people, those living in residential care and individuals with underlying health concerns, there are serious questions about the infection control measures, the availability of treatment, support for care providers and the steps being taken to prevent further outbreaks. An urgent statement would provide an opportunity for the Welsh Government to update Members on the current scale and extent of the outbreak in west Wales, measures being taken to contain transmission and protect vulnerable individuals, guidance being provided to care homes, hospitals and community healthcare providers, and whether additional resources or support are being made available to affected areas. Given the significant public concern and the potential implications for public health, I believe that this matter warrants an urgent statement at the earliest opportunity. Diolch.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Drefnydd, a gaf i ofyn am ddatganiad brys gan y Gweinidog Cabinet dros Iechyd a Gofal ynglŷn â'r achosion o'r clefyd crafu yn ardal bwrdd iechyd Hywel Dda, a digonolrwydd ymateb Llywodraeth Cymru i'r pryder iechyd cyhoeddus hwn sy'n datblygu? Mae pryder cynyddol am ledaeniad y clefyd crafu o fewn cymunedau a lleoliadau gofal. Mae'r sefyllfa wedi dod hyd yn oed yn fwy pryderus yn dilyn marwolaeth gŵr oedrannus, y mae ei salwch yn gysylltiedig â chymhlethdodau sy'n gysylltiedig â'r clefyd crafu. O ystyried bod pobl hŷn yn agored i niwed, felly hefyd y rhai sy'n byw mewn gofal preswyl ac unigolion sydd â phryderon iechyd sylfaenol, mae cwestiynau difrifol am y mesurau rheoli heintiau, argaeledd triniaeth, cymorth i ddarparwyr gofal a'r camau sy'n cael eu cymryd i atal achosion pellach. Byddai datganiad brys yn rhoi cyfle i Lywodraeth Cymru roi'r wybodaeth ddiweddaraf i'r Aelodau am raddfa a maint presennol yr achosion yn y gorllewin, mesurau sy'n cael eu cymryd i atal trosglwyddiad ac i amddiffyn unigolion agored i niwed, canllawiau sy'n cael eu darparu i gartrefi gofal, ysbytai a darparwyr gofal iechyd cymunedol, ac a yw adnoddau neu gymorth ychwanegol ar gael i'r ardaloedd yr effeithir arnynt. O ystyried y pryder cyhoeddus sylweddol a'r goblygiadau posibl i iechyd y cyhoedd, credaf fod y mater hwn yn haeddu datganiad brys ar y cyfle cyntaf. Diolch.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Business Statement and Announcement

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch i'r Aelod am godi'r mater hwn. Dwi'n gobeithio eich bod chi hefyd wedi cymryd y cyfle i ysgrifennu at y Gweinidog Cabinet dros Iechyd a Gofal. Mae yna gwestiynau i'r Gweinidog yfory yma yn y Senedd, a gobeithio y bydd yna gyfle i godi'r materion pwysig hyn. Yn sicr, gadewch i fi fod yn glir, mae diogelwch cleifion yn parhau i fod yn flaenoriaeth lwyr i'r Llywodraeth hon. Rydyn ni'n disgwyl i bob bwrdd iechyd gael trefniadau atal a rheoli heintiau cadarn ar waith i atal, adnabod a rheoli achosion yn effeithiol. Mi fyddaf i hefyd yn sicrhau bod y Gweinidog Cabinet yn ymwybodol eich bod chi wedi codi'r mater hwn efo fi heddiw.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: I thank the Member for raising this issue. I do hope that you took the opportunity to write to the Cabinet Minister for Health and Care. There are questions to the Minister tomorrow here in the Senedd, and hopefully, you'll have an opportunity to raise these important issues. Let me be clear that patient safety continues to be a full priority for this Government. We expect every health board to have disease control processes in place in order to control cases effectively. I will also ensure that the Cabinet Minister is aware that you raised this issue with me today.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: I'm requesting a Government statement on its tourism strategy. A strategy is not saying that tourism is important to the Welsh economy and that we want it. Which tourism sectors does the Welsh Government think are important? How are they going to target groups? How will they distinguish between day tourists and overnight tourists? I would prioritise active tourism, such as hiking, cycling and golf. The question is can we share golf tourism with Ireland. Has anybody asked? I would also prioritise cultural tourism to eisteddfods and historical buildings, including chapels and churches. But we do need a strategy.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Rwy'n gofyn am ddatganiad gan y Llywodraeth ar ei strategaeth dwristiaeth. Nid yw strategaeth yn golygu dweud bod twristiaeth yn bwysig i economi Cymru a'n bod ni ei eisiau. Pa sectorau twristiaeth y mae Llywodraeth Cymru yn meddwl sy'n bwysig? Sut maen nhw'n mynd i dargedu grwpiau? Sut byddant yn gwahaniaethu rhwng twristiaid dydd a thwristiaid dros nos? Byddwn yn blaenoriaethu twristiaeth egnïol, fel heicio, beicio a golff. Y cwestiwn yw a allwn ni rannu twristiaeth golff gydag Iwerddon. Oes unrhyw un wedi gofyn? Byddwn hefyd yn blaenoriaethu twristiaeth ddiwylliannol i eisteddfodau ac adeiladau hanesyddol, gan gynnwys capeli ac eglwysi. Ond mae angen strategaeth arnom.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch yn fawr iawn i'r Aelod. Dwi'n falch eich bod chi'n cytuno efo fi bod angen strategaeth ddiwylliant a chwaraeon newydd i Gymru, a fydd yn cynnwys ffocws ar yr economi a thwristiaeth. Byddwn i'n annog pob Aelod i ymwneud â'r ymgynghoriad hwnnw, sydd ar agor tan 18 Rhagfyr. Dwi'n edrych ymlaen yn fawr at dderbyn sylwadau Mike Hedges ac i'w hystyried nhw'n fanwl wrth inni ddatblygu a llunio'r strategaeth honno.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Thank you very much to the Member. I'm pleased that you agree with me that we do need a new culture and sport strategy, which will include a focus on the economy and tourism. I would encourage every Member to engage with that consultation, which is open until 18 December. I'm looking forward greatly to receiving Mike Hedges's comments as we develop that strategy.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Can I call for two statements today, please? The first is from the Cabinet Secretary for Enterprise, Connectivity and Energy in relation to the mobile network. Action has been taken in Scotland and England, and they've announced this week in Scotland a consultation on changing permitted development rights in order to address mobile black spots. Given the essential nature of a decent mobile signal now, Wales is falling behind with this important digital infrastructure. We clearly need some action here, and I would be grateful if we could have an update on what action the Welsh Government is taking.

Also, can I call for a statement from the Welsh Government Cabinet Secretary responsible for social justice and equality on the action being taken by the Welsh Government to address antisemitism in Wales? As we all know, tomorrow marks the third anniversary of those barbaric attacks by Hamas and Islamic Jihad terrorists against Israeli citizens. All of us have condemned those attacks, and what we need to make sure is that Wales is taking appropriate action to address the rise in antisemitism that we've seen in our country since.

One positive action that the previous Welsh Government took, of course, was to recognise the International Holocaust Remembrance Alliance's definition of antisemitism, and I'd be grateful if the Welsh Government could reaffirm its commitment to that definition so that we can be sure that the same action will be taken by this new Welsh Government as the previous one in terms of providing some leadership on that issue.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
A gaf i alw am ddau ddatganiad heddiw, os gwelwch yn dda? Mae'r cyntaf gan Ysgrifennydd y Cabinet dros Fenter, Cysylltedd ac Ynni mewn perthynas â'r rhwydwaith symudol. Mae camau wedi cael eu cymryd yn yr Alban a Lloegr, ac maen nhw wedi cyhoeddi, yr wythnos hon yn yr Alban, ymgynghoriad ar newid hawliau datblygu a ganiateir er mwyn mynd i'r afael â mannau duon symudol. O ystyried natur hanfodol signal symudol digonol nawr, mae Cymru yn syrthio ar ei hôl hi gyda'r seilwaith digidol pwysig hwn. Mae'n amlwg bod angen rhywfaint o weithredu yma, a byddwn yn ddiolchgar pe gallwn gael yr wybodaeth ddiweddaraf am y camau y mae Llywodraeth Cymru yn eu cymryd.

Hefyd, a gaf i alw am ddatganiad gan Ysgrifennydd Cabinet Llywodraeth Cymru sy'n gyfrifol am gyfiawnder cymdeithasol a chydraddoldeb ar y camau sy'n cael eu cymryd gan Lywodraeth Cymru i fynd i'r afael â gwrthsemitiaeth yng Nghymru? Fel y gwyddom i gyd, mae yfory yn nodi trydydd pen-blwydd yr ymosodiadau barbaraidd hynny gan derfysgwyr Hamas a Jihad Islamaidd yn erbyn dinasyddion Israel. Mae pob un ohonom wedi condemnio'r ymosodiadau hynny, a'r hyn y mae angen i ni ei sicrhau yw bod Cymru'n cymryd camau priodol i fynd i'r afael â'r cynnydd mewn gwrthsemitiaeth yr ydym wedi'i weld yn ein gwlad ers hynny.

Un cam gweithredu cadarnhaol a gymerodd Llywodraeth Cymru flaenorol, wrth gwrs, oedd cydnabod diffiniad Cynghrair Ryngwladol Cofio’r Holocost o wrthsemitiaeth, a byddwn yn ddiolchgar pe gallai Llywodraeth Cymru ailddatgan ei hymrwymiad i'r diffiniad hwnnw fel y gallwn fod yn sicr y bydd yr un camau yn cael eu cymryd gan y Llywodraeth newydd hon â'r un blaenorol o ran darparu rhywfaint o arweinyddiaeth ar y mater hwnnw.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Dwi'n gobeithio bod yr Aelod wedi clywed y Prif Weinidog yn gyfan gwbl ddiamwys yn gynharach o ran ein bod ni'n condemnio'n llwyr unrhyw wrthsemitiaeth. Dwi'n gobeithio ein bod ni'n unedig fel Senedd ar hynny. 

Hefyd, mae'r Dirprwy Brif Weinidog, yn ei gwaith fel y Gweinidog Cabinet dros Gyfiawnder Cymdeithasol a Chydraddoldeb, wedi bod yn edrych ar y 'Cynllun Gweithredu Cymru Wrth-hiliol' i sicrhau ei fod o'n addas i bwrpas, gan adlewyrchu'r hyn rydyn ni wedi'i weld o ran twf mewn casineb o bob math, gan gynnwys gwrthsemitiaeth. Mi fyddaf i'n sicr o godi efo hi'r pwyntiau rydych chi wedi'u codi efo fi heddiw.

O ran y pwynt cyntaf, yn amlwg, mae isadeiledd digidol yn allweddol bwysig; mae'n allweddol bwysig i'n heconomi. Dwi'n gwybod bod hwn yn rhywbeth mae'r Gweinidog Cabinet yn ei gymryd o ddifrif. Mi fyddaf i'n codi'r pwyntiau penodol y gwnaethoch chi ac yn sicrhau bod diweddariad o ran y gwaith hwnnw.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
I hope that the Member will have heard the First Minister state unambiguously earlier that we totally condemn any antisemitism. I hope that we can be united as a Senedd on that.

Also, the Deputy First Minister, in her work as Cabinet Minister for Social Justice and Equality, has been looking at the 'Anti-racist Wales Action Plan' to ensure that it is fit for purpose, reflecting on what we have seen in terms of the increase in hate of all types, including antisemitism. I will certainly raise your points with her.

In terms of your first point, clearly, digital infrastructure is crucially important; it's important for our economy. I know that this is something that the Cabinet Minister is taking seriously. I will raise the specific points that you made with him and ensure that there is an update on that work.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Trefnydd, in a free society, we show our faces. It's how we recognise each other, it's how we trust each other, it's how we talk to each other. A nurse needs to see their patient, a teacher needs to see their parent at the school gate. For public safety, it's important. Reform's position is clear: we would ban the burqa and every other full face covering in public. Trefnydd, could we please have a statement setting out the Welsh Government's position on this? I know this matter falls outside the Senedd's powers, but if the Welsh Government will be making representations to the UK Government on Wales's behalf, it would be beneficial for this entire Senedd to understand your position on this. Also, feel free to sign our petition on this. Diolch.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Drefnydd, mewn cymdeithas rydd, rydyn ni'n dangos ein hwynebau. Dyna sut rydyn ni'n adnabod ein gilydd, dyna sut rydyn ni'n ymddiried yn ein gilydd, dyna sut rydyn ni'n siarad â'n gilydd. Mae angen i nyrs weld ei chlaf, mae angen i athro weld ei riant wrth giât yr ysgol. Er diogelwch y cyhoedd, mae'n bwysig. Mae safbwynt Reform yn glir: byddem yn gwahardd y burqa a phob gorchudd wyneb llawn arall mewn mannau cyhoeddus. Drefnydd, a gawn ni ddatganiad yn nodi safbwynt Llywodraeth Cymru ar hyn? Rwy'n gwybod bod y mater hwn y tu allan i bwerau'r Senedd, ond os bydd Llywodraeth Cymru yn cyflwyno sylwadau i Lywodraeth y DU ar ran Cymru, byddai'n fuddiol i'r Senedd gyfan ddeall eich safbwynt ar hyn. Hefyd, mae croeso i chi lofnodi ein deiseb ar hyn. Diolch.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Business Statement and Announcement

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Na, fydd yna ddim datganiad ar y mater hwn. Fel mae'r Aelod wedi nodi, mae hwn yn fater sydd ddim wedi ei ddatganoli. Ond gaf i fod yn glir, fel oeddwn i yn fy ymateb i i Darren Millar rŵan? Mae'r Llywodraeth hon yn condemnio unrhyw fath o hiliaeth, unrhyw fath o roi'r syniad nad yw rhywun yn haeddu gallu byw eu bywydau yn unol â'r ffordd y maen nhw'n cael yr hawl i fyw eu bywydau. Mae hiliaeth yn rhywbeth sydd yn broblem fawr o fewn cymdeithas ar y funud. Mae hwn yn rhywbeth mae etholwyr yn ei ddweud wrthym ni yn gyson. Mae yna gyfrifoldeb ar bob un ohonon ni yn y Siambr hon i sicrhau ein bod ni yn cefnogi pawb rydyn ni'n eu cynrychioli, pob aelod o gymdeithas, a sicrhau bod pawb yn teimlo'n ddiogel, a'n bod ni i gyd yn cydweithio i sicrhau nad yw hiliaeth yn parhau yma yng Nghymru. Does dim lle i hiliaeth yng Nghymru.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: No, there will be no statement on this issue. As the Member has noted, this is an issue that is not devolved. But could I be clear, as I was in response to Darren Millar just now? This Government condemns all forms of racism, any idea that someone doesn't deserve to be able to live their life in the way that they have the right to live that life. Racism is a great problem in society now, and that's something that constituents tell us consistently. We all have a responsibility in this Chamber to ensure that we do support everyone that we represent, all members of society, and ensure that everyone feels safe, and that we all co-operate to ensure that racism doesn't continue here in Wales. There is no place for racism in Wales.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Minister, can I please request a statement from the Cabinet Minister for health and social care on support for people living with Huntington's disease? Huntington's is a rare neurological condition where symptoms affect thinking and cognitive abilities, as well as movement and behaviour. Symptoms usually develop between the ages of 30 and 50, with life expectancy from diagnosis being just 20 years. Anyone who has a parent with a faulty gene has a one in two chance of having Huntington's themselves. It's a really complex condition, with people requiring support from a number of health and care professionals. There's also a considerable mental health burden, with people often caring for family members whilst worrying about potentially carrying the faulty gene themselves.

Guidance published by the previous Welsh Government makes clear that those with a neurological condition such as Huntington's disease should not be excluded from mental health services. Guidance also calls for co-ordination of care across services, professions and agencies. Too many people say the healthcare service they access does not, in fact, meet their needs. A statement from the Cabinet Minister setting out what action the Welsh Government is taking to ensure that people with this devastating disease get the mental health support that they need and have a health professional to co-ordinate their care would be greatly appreciated. Thank you.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Weinidog, a gaf i ofyn am ddatganiad gan Weinidog y Cabinet dros iechyd a gofal cymdeithasol ar gymorth i bobl sy'n byw gyda chlefyd Huntington? Mae clefyd Huntington yn gyflwr niwrolegol prin pan fo symptomau'n effeithio ar alluoedd meddwl a gwybyddol, yn ogystal â symud ac ymddygiad. Mae symptomau fel arfer yn datblygu rhwng 30 a 50 oed, gyda disgwyliad oes ar ôl diagnosis yn ddim ond 20 mlynedd. Mae gan unrhyw un sydd â rhiant â genyn diffygiol siawns un mewn dau o gael clefyd Huntington ei hun. Mae'n gyflwr cymhleth iawn, gyda phobl angen cymorth gan nifer o weithwyr iechyd a gofal proffesiynol. Mae baich iechyd meddwl sylweddol hefyd, gyda phobl yn aml yn gofalu am aelodau o'r teulu gan boeni eu bod yn cario'r genyn diffygiol eu hunain.

Mae canllawiau a gyhoeddwyd gan Lywodraeth flaenorol Cymru yn gwneud yn glir na ddylid eithrio'r rhai sydd â chyflwr niwrolegol fel clefyd Huntington o wasanaethau iechyd meddwl. Mae canllawiau hefyd yn galw am gydlynu gofal ar draws gwasanaethau, proffesiynau ac asiantaethau. Mae gormod o bobl yn dweud nad yw'r gwasanaeth gofal iechyd y maent yn cael mynediad ato, mewn gwirionedd, yn diwallu eu hanghenion. Byddai datganiad gan Weinidog y Cabinet yn nodi pa gamau y mae Llywodraeth Cymru yn eu cymryd i sicrhau bod pobl â'r clefyd dinistriol hwn yn cael y cymorth iechyd meddwl sydd ei angen arnynt a bod ganddynt weithiwr iechyd proffesiynol i gydlynu eu gofal yn cael ei werthfawrogi'n fawr. Diolch.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch i'r Aelod am godi mater dwi'n siŵr mae nifer o etholwyr wedi ei godi gyda ni. Dwi'n gwybod ei fod o'n fater yn sydd wedi ei godi gyda fi drwy waith achos. Fe fyddwch chi wedi fy nghlywed i'n dweud bod gan y Gweinidog Cabinet dros Iechyd a Gofal gwestiynau yfory, felly mae yna gyfle i godi hyn bryd hynny. Byddwn i hefyd yn gofyn i'r Aelod, os nad ydy hi eisoes wedi, ysgrifennu at y Gweinidog Cabinet i sicrhau ei bod hi'n cael ateb llawn ar y mater hwn.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: I thank the Member for raising an issue that I'm sure a number of constituents have raised with us. I know that it's an issue that's been raised with me in casework. You will have heard me say that the Cabinet Minister for Health and Care has questions tomorrow, so there is an opportunity to raise this at that point. I would also ask the Member, if she hasn't already done so, to write to the Cabinet Minister to ensure that she gets a full response on this issue.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Trefnydd, could I ask for a statement from the Cabinet Secretary for health and social care on the operation of the 'Listening to People' NHS complaints process? Constituents have raised concerns with me following their experience of pursuing complaints involving Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board. The new system places clear requirements on health bodies, including acknowledgement within five working days and a 10 working day early resolution stage. However, concerns have been raised with me about what happens when a patient believes that the health board itself has failed to follow those requirements. Could we therefore have a statement from the Cabinet Secretary explaining how compliance with 'Listening to People' is monitored, what action the Welsh Government can take where a health board is not compliant, and what effective route is available to a patient who believes the complaints process itself has failed? Thank you.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Drefnydd, a gaf i ofyn am ddatganiad gan Ysgrifennydd y Cabinet dros iechyd a gofal cymdeithasol ar weithrediad proses gwynion y GIG, 'Gwrando ar Bobl'? Mae etholwyr wedi codi pryderon gyda mi yn dilyn eu profiad o fynd ar drywydd cwynion yn ymwneud â Bwrdd Iechyd Prifysgol Betsi Cadwaladr. Mae'r system newydd yn gosod gofynion clir ar gyrff iechyd, gan gynnwys cydnabyddiaeth o fewn pum niwrnod gwaith a cham datrys cynnar 10 diwrnod gwaith. Fodd bynnag, mae pryderon wedi cael eu codi gyda mi ynglŷn â'r hyn sy'n digwydd pan fydd claf yn credu bod y bwrdd iechyd ei hun wedi methu â dilyn y gofynion hynny. Felly a allwn gael datganiad gan yr Ysgrifennydd Cabinet yn esbonio sut mae cydymffurfiaeth â 'Gwrando ar Bobl' yn cael ei fonitro, pa gamau y gall Llywodraeth Cymru eu cymryd pan nad yw bwrdd iechyd yn cydymffurfio, a pha lwybr effeithiol sydd ar gael i glaf sy'n credu bod y broses gwyno ei hun wedi methu? Diolch.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch i'r Aelod am godi'r materion hyn. Fel y byddwch chi wedi fy nghlywed i'n dweud, mae gan y Gweinidog Cabinet dros Iechyd a Gofal gwestiynau yfory, ond hefyd, oherwydd natur y pryderon rydych chi wedi eu codi a bod yna enghreifftiau penodol, mi fyddwn i yn gofyn i chi ysgrifennu at y Gweinidog Cabinet a chodi'r pryderon pendant hyn. Yn amlwg, dydych chi ddim wedi datgelu'r holl wybodaeth fan hyn—ni fyddai'n briodol. Ond oherwydd natur yr hyn rydych chi wedi ei godi, mae'n hollbwysig ei fod o'n cael y manylion hyn. Fe fyddwch chi yn ymwybodol bod Bwrdd Iechyd Prifysgol Betsi Cadwaladr yn parhau i fod ar y lefel uchaf o sgrwtini, a'n bod ni yn gweithio'n galed i sicrhau bod goruchwyliaeth a chraffu gan Lywodraeth Cymru yna er mwyn targedu gwelliannau angenrheidiol mewn gofal cleifion a darparu gwasanaethau. Felly, mae sicrhau bod gan y Gweinidog Cabinet yr wybodaeth honno yn allweddol bwysig.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: I thank the Member for raising these issues. As you'll have heard me say, the Cabinet Minister for Health and Care has questions tomorrow, but because of the concerns that you've raised and that there are specific examples, I would ask you to write to the Cabinet Minister and raise those specific concerns. Obviously, you haven't disclosed all the information here—it wouldn't be appropriate. But because of the nature of what you've raised, it's important that he does receive those details. You'll be aware that Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board continues to be at the highest level of scrutiny and that we are working very hard to ensure that oversight and scrutiny by the Welsh Government are present in order to target necessary improvements in patient care and the provision of services. And so, ensuring that the Cabinet Minister has that information is vital.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Prynhawn da, Drefnydd. Can I ask for a statement, please, on radical reform of services for our care-experienced young people? Back in July 2023, we debated in the Senedd the Children, Young People and Education Committee's report on this subject. Of the committee's 12 radical recommendations, the then Government accepted just one, rejecting—amongst other things—making care experience a protected characteristic and placing corporate duties on a statutory level. In that debate the now Deputy First Minister shared my disappointment that the Government then said it wasn't sufficiently bold, brave or ambitious. So, given that situation, I'd be pleased to hear from Plaid Cymru exactly how they're going to incorporate these issues around radical reform. It hasn't been so far in your statement for government or in your manifesto, but you've had a busy time, so I'm hoping that there will be a focus now on ensuring that our care-experienced young people across Wales get the services that they deserve. Diolch yn fawr iawn.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Prynhawn da, Drefnydd. A gaf i ofyn am ddatganiad, os gwelwch yn dda, ar ddiwygio gwasanaethau radical i'n pobl ifanc sydd â phrofiad o fod mewn gofal? Yn ôl ym mis Gorffennaf 2023, fe wnaethom drafod yn y Senedd adroddiad y Pwyllgor Plant, Pobl Ifanc ac Addysg ar y pwnc hwn. O'r 12 argymhelliad radical y pwyllgor, derbyniodd y Llywodraeth ar y pryd un yn unig, gan wrthod—ymhlith pethau eraill—gwneud profiad o fod mewn gofal yn nodwedd warchodedig a gosod dyletswyddau corfforaethol ar lefel statudol. Yn y ddadl honno, rhannodd y Dirprwy Brif Weinidog fy siom bod y Llywodraeth wedyn wedi dweud nad oedd yn ddigon beiddgar, dewr nac uchelgeisiol. Felly, o ystyried y sefyllfa honno, byddwn yn falch o glywed gan Blaid Cymru yn union sut maen nhw'n mynd i ymgorffori'r materion hyn ynghylch diwygio radical. Nid yw wedi bod hyd yn hyn yn eich datganiad llywodraethu nac yn eich maniffesto, ond rydych chi wedi cael amser prysur, felly rwy'n gobeithio y bydd ffocws nawr ar sicrhau bod ein pobl ifanc sydd â phrofiad o fod mewn gofal ledled Cymru yn cael y gwasanaethau y maent yn eu haeddu. Diolch yn fawr iawn.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Diolch i'r Aelod am godi'r mater yma. Yn amlwg, fe fyddwch chi yn gwybod am ymrwymiad Plaid Cymru o ran yr hyn dŷch chi wedi'i amlinellu. Mae'r Dirprwy Weinidog gyda chyfrifoldeb dros hyn wedi clywed yr hyn dŷch chi wedi ei godi heddiw.

Mae dileu elw o'r sector gofal yn fater y buom yn ei ddatblygu yn ystod y cytundeb cydweithio hefyd, ac mae'r ddeddfwriaeth honno bellach yn ei lle ac yn symud tuag at weithredu yn ystod y tymor seneddol hwn. Bu i'r Llywodraeth flaenorol lofnodi'r datganiad yn 2025. Fel Llywodraeth newydd, dŷn ni yn cefnogi'r egwyddor o greu system gofal sy'n canolbwyntio'n fwy ar deuluoedd, wedi'i seilio ar hawliau, sy'n trauma informed, wedi'i gwreiddio'n lleol ac sy'n uchelgeisiol ar gyfer yr holl blant, wrth ddod i ben â gwneud elw o ofal plant a sicrhau nad ydy unrhyw berson ifanc yn gadael gofal i ddigartrefedd hefyd. Dwi'n gobeithio'n fawr, achos y ffaith eich bod chi wedi clywed hyn, Ddirprwy Weinidog, y bydd yna gyfle i chithau a'r Aelod drafod hyn ymhellach.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
I thank the Member for raising this issue. Clearly, you will be aware of Plaid Cymru's commitment in terms of what you've outlined. The Deputy Minister with responsibility for this has heard the comments that you have made this afternoon.

Removing profit from the care sector is an issue that we worked on during the co-operation agreement, and that legislation is now in place and we're moving towards implementation during this Senedd term. The previous Government did sign a statement in 2025. As a new Government, we do support the principle of creating a care system that is more focused on families, is based on rights, is trauma informed, is locally rooted and is ambitious for all children, whilst removing profit from childcare and ensuring that no young person leaves care and goes into homelessness also. I do very much hope, given the fact that you will have heard this, Deputy Minister, that there will be an opportunity for you and the Member to discuss this issue further.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Trefnydd, can I ask for a statement on the Government's plans for improving pre-application consultations for major energy infrastructure developments, including solar farms, windfarms, new pylons and substations? My constituents feel ignored and dismayed. They believe these applications are just tick-box exercises. They tell me that notices intended to inform them are put up in places where they cannot be seen. They say letters arrive so late they have no meaningful chance to respond. To them, it feels like they are being deliberately denied a voice in decisions that will affect their homes and communities. They say they are being treated like mushrooms: fed farmyard manure and kept in the dark. So, Trefnydd, will the Government make a statement on how it will improve pre-application consultations for major energy infrastructure developments and ensure that communities are genuinely heard? Diolch.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Drefnydd, a gaf i ofyn am ddatganiad ar gynlluniau'r Llywodraeth ar gyfer gwella ymgynghoriadau cyn gwneud cais ar gyfer datblygiadau seilwaith ynni mawr, gan gynnwys ffermydd solar, ffermydd gwynt, a pheilonau ac is-orsafoedd newydd? Mae fy etholwyr yn teimlo eu bod yn cael eu hanwybyddu ac maen nhw wedi'u siomi. Maen nhw'n credu mai ymarferion ticio blwch yn unig yw'r ceisiadau hyn. Maen nhw'n dweud wrthyf fod hysbysiadau sydd i fod i'w hysbysu nhw yn cael eu gosod mewn mannau lle na ellir eu gweld. Maen nhw'n dweud bod llythyrau yn cyrraedd mor hwyr nad oes ganddynt unrhyw gyfle ystyrlon i ymateb. Iddyn nhw, mae'n teimlo fel nad oes ganddyn nhw lais mewn penderfyniadau a fydd yn effeithio ar eu cartrefi a'u cymunedau a hynny'n fwriadol. Maen nhw'n dweud eu bod yn cael eu trin fel madarch: yn cael eu bwydo â thail iard fferm a'u cadw yn y tywyllwch. Felly, Drefnydd, a wnaiff y Llywodraeth wneud datganiad ar sut y bydd yn gwella ymgynghoriadau cyn gwneud cais ar gyfer datblygiadau seilwaith ynni mawr ac yn sicrhau bod cymunedau'n cael eu clywed o ddifrif? Diolch.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch i'r Aelod am godi'r materion hyn. Mae yna ymrwymiad clir gan y Llywodraeth hon o ran ein bod ni'n datblygu strategaeth ynni genedlaethol sydd yn mynd i'r afael â'r heriau hyn ac sy'n cynnwys cymunedau yn lle gwneud pethau i gymunedau, sef un o'r pwyntiau y mae'r Aelod yn eu codi. Mi fydd yna ddiweddariad i'r Senedd wrth i'r gwaith hwnnw fynd rhagddo.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: I thank the Member for raising these issues. There is a clear commitment from this Government in terms of the fact that we are developing a national energy strategy that tackles these challenges and includes communities instead of doing things to communities, which is one of the points that the Member has raised. There will be an update to the Senedd as that work proceeds.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Weinidog, a gaf i groesawu yn y lle cyntaf yn fawr iawn gyhoeddiad Llywodraeth Plaid Cymru yr wythnos diwethaf ynghylch y £3.4 miliwn ychwanegol i fwrdd iechyd Powys i helpu i leihau amseroedd aros? Fe fydd y buddsoddiad hwn yn gwneud gwahaniaeth i gleifion ym Mhowys, lle mae nifer fawr yn dibynnu ar gael mynediad at wasanaethau gofal iechyd ar draws y ffin yn Lloegr. O ystyried y rôl hanfodol y mae gofal iechyd trawsffiniol yn ei chwarae i bobl ym Mhowys ac ar hyd Clawdd Offa, a oes modd cael sylw ar hyn, os gwelwch yn dda?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Minister, may I first of all warmly welcome the Plaid Cymru Government's announcement last week regarding the additional £3.4 million for Powys health board to help to reduce waiting times? This investment will make a difference to patients in Powys, where a large number depend on accessing healthcare services across the border in England. Given the vital role that cross-border healthcare plays for people in Powys and along Offa's Dyke, can we have a statement on this, please?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch am godi'r mater hwn. Rwy'n falch eich bod chi yn croesawu'r buddsoddiad pwysig hwnnw. Dŷn ni eisiau sicrhau ein bod ni yn parhau i sicrhau gwasanaeth iechyd sy'n gweithio i bawb, ble bynnag y maen nhw yng Nghymru. Yn sicr, mi fyddaf yn codi efo'r Gweinidog Cabinet y pwyntiau dŷch chi wedi'u codi heddiw.

We want to ensure that we do continue to ensure a health service that works for everyone, wherever they are in Wales. Certainly, I will raise with the Cabinet Minister the points that you've raised today.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Thank you, Deputy Presiding Officer. I'd like to ask for a statement from the Cabinet Minister for Rural Resilience and Sustainability on how the Welsh Government intends to turn the lessons from this summer's wildfires and the very real risk of flooding this autumn and winter into investment in rural communities such as those across Brycheiniog Tawe Nedd.

Research has highlighted that measures such as rewetting peatland and better land management can help prevent wildfires, while also slowing water run-off and reducing flood risk. Indeed, the Welsh Government has already committed more than £5 million to natural flood management this financial year. So, could we have a statement setting out how farmers and landowners will be supported to deliver landscape-scale resilience and whether the Welsh Government will use this opportunity to bring much-needed investment and jobs into rural communities like mine?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Diolch, Ddirprwy Lywydd. Hoffwn ofyn am ddatganiad gan Weinidog y Cabinet dros Wydnwch Gwledig a Chynaliadwyedd ar sut mae Llywodraeth Cymru yn bwriadu troi'r gwersi yn sgil tanau gwyllt yr haf hwn a'r perygl gwirioneddol iawn o lifogydd yr hydref a'r gaeaf hwn yn fuddsoddiad mewn cymunedau gwledig fel y rhai ar draws Brycheiniog Tawe Nedd.

Mae ymchwil wedi amlygu y gall mesurau fel ailwlychu mawndir a rheoli tir yn well helpu i atal tanau gwyllt, gan hefyd arafu dŵr ffo a lleihau'r perygl o lifogydd. Yn wir, mae Llywodraeth Cymru eisoes wedi ymrwymo mwy na £5 miliwn i reoli llifogydd naturiol y flwyddyn ariannol hon. Felly, a allwn ni gael datganiad yn nodi sut y bydd ffermwyr a thirfeddianwyr yn cael eu cefnogi i sicrhau gwydnwch ar raddfa tirwedd ac a fydd Llywodraeth Cymru yn defnyddio'r cyfle hwn i ddod â buddsoddiad a swyddi mawr eu hangen i gymunedau gwledig fel fy un i?

Diolch i’r Aelod am godi materion a gafodd gryn sylw, wrth gwrs, pan wnaeth y Prif Weinidog ddatganiad ar y pwnc hwn rai wythnosau yn ôl, a gwneud yr union bwyntiau hynny o ran datrysiadau o ran natur a rôl ffermwyr hefyd o ran hyn. Ac yn sicr, mae hon yn drafodaeth sydd wrth wraidd nifer o drafodaethau trawsweinidogol y Llywodraeth hon.

I ni fod yn glir, y Prif Weinidog sy’n arwain o ran gwydnwch, ac wedyn mae Gweinidogion unigol, megis y Gweinidog Cabinet dros Wydnwch Gwledig a Chynaliadwyedd, yn amlwg yn cymryd rhan o ran llifogydd ac ati, ac o ran polisïau cefn gwlad a ffermwyr. Felly, mae’r cydweithio hwnnw yn bwysig.

Mi oedd yna ddatganiad. Mi godwyd hyn adeg hynny wrth i’r gwaith hwnnw fynd rhagddo. Wrth gwrs, bydd yna fwy o gyfleoedd i Aelodau gael craffu, holi cwestiynau a mewnbynnu i’r gwaith hwnnw.

I thank the Member for raising issues that got quite a bit of attention, of course, when the First Minister made a statement on this issue some weeks ago, and made those very points in terms of nature-based solutions and the role of farmers too in this regard. And certainly, this is an issue that is at the heart of many of the cross-departmental discussions within this Government. 

To be clear, the First Minister leads on resilience, and then individual Ministers, such as the Cabinet Minister for Rural Resilience and Sustainability, clearly have a role in terms of flooding and so on, and in terms of rural policy and farmers. So, that collaboration is important.
